201003.description:
Shaoran (Xiaolian) is an orphaned girl who lives alone in the mountains at the very nook of an impoverished village. One day, an envoy from the palace arrives and scouts her to to be a lady-in-waiting for the imperial harem. This was how a wild girl raised on the mountains was able to live in a luxurious palace working as a lady-in-waiting, however...

On her first day (due to various reasons), Shaoran had suddenly become a criminal after slapping one of the consorts.

Though execution appeared certain, she was specially pardoned and demoted from a lady-in-waiting to a maidservant in charge of odd jobs. She is ridiculed by the other consorts as the, "Princess of Odd Jobs," however, this is where her rapid advance begins. She implements reforms to the worn-down palace and optimizes her chores through the knowledge she learned from her life of living in poverty, earning the gaze of the other ladies-in-waiting and the imperial consorts alike. Continuing these course of events, Shaoran's name spreads through the imperial palace, reaching even the emperor's ears...

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

Apathetic chaebol heir Tae-Seo Gwon drifts aimlessly through life until a scandal sees him banished to Seongu Village—a backwater town so isolated it lacks even a cafe. There, he meets Yu-Na An, a resilient convenience store worker enduring a harsh home life. Much to his surprise, her warmth breaks through his cynical exterior and ignites a deep bond between them. Over four years, Yu-Na defies all odds to become a rising star. But when Tae-Seo’s older brother pressures her to walk away, Yu-Na makes a devastating choice to disappear, leaving Tae-Seo in utter shock.

201024.description:
Mansuk, a low-born slave, was abandoned in the mountains right after birth, supposedly for stealing the energy of the Samsin Halmae (goddess of childbirth). Fortunately, he was picked up by a peddler and wandered through the eight provinces of Joseon. Thanks to his natural eloquence and quick wit, Mansuk achieved great success as both a righteous hero and a swindler. Believing that 'a swindler starves if he becomes famous,' he prepares for his last big score. His final goal is to steal the blue and white porcelain belonging to Lord Park, Hanyang's wealthiest man. However, he fails and is caught. Under Lord Park's command, he becomes a 'fake eunuch' and infiltrates the palace – as the exclusive eunuch for Queen Gyeongye, who is said to be even scarier than the King!

But the reality was far more devastating. Siché had traveled back in time to the day she met Roena. This time, Siché will quench her thirst for vengeance. 201034.description:
Kwon Tae-Shin is a man worn thin by indulgence. A VIP at the exclusive members-only club Zeus, he buys fleeting nights with ease, yet never repeats the same encounter twice, forever chasing something that can cut through his suffocating boredom. Lee Won-Woo, a low-level club employee and the sole provider for his family, never expects to cross Tae-Shin’s path until he is assigned to drive him home one night. On a whim, Tae-shin makes him an offer that changes everything, proposing to buy a night with him instead. Stunned but tempted by the staggering amount of money, Won-Woo accepts, only to emerge from the experience shaken and regretful. He tries to avoid Tae-shin afterward, hoping to put it all behind him. But Tae-Shin is no longer bored.

Fixated on the one man who managed to leave a mark on him, he begins to pursue Won-Woo with unsettling persistence, turning a single reckless decision into a dangerous and irresistible entanglement.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

201035.description:
Death comes to Gwon Young by scent. Every ten years, the person Young loves most dies. Hoping to escape the curse, he moves away. But then he meets An Ji-Ho, a man who seems to be quietly waiting for the end of his own life. Their connection forms fast and deep, filling the emptiness they both carry. But with another ten-year mark approaching, Young can’t shake the scent of death on the air.

(Source: Lezhin US)

201038.description:
A princess of the Western Regions, raped by invaders, gave birth to a prince. She died while fleeing to save her son, leaving behind a will for revenge. The prince, stranded on the frontier as a beggar, later joined a slave troop, befriended a long-haired young man, and fell in love with him. The prince, seeking revenge, sought to win over the people and observe the situation. Upon learning his origins, the young man decided to help him. The prince became a handyman slave, seeking to gain the trust of the powerful and assassinate the king at a palace banquet, avenging the destruction of his kingdom and the murder of his mother.

A fool for love, he's only too happy to be the perfect husband who meets her every need…little does he know that Aiko takes him for granted and is having a steamy affair with her supervisor at work! But there's a bit of a problem...this "ex" for some reason is far more affectionate towards her than she remembers?!

Suzuki and Satou think they’re only having sex with their teacher to protect their reputation and earn some extra cash. He has weird fantasies of disciplining them with his cock. It’s creepy, but it, like, kind of feels good…? Maybe getting teased and edged isn’t that bad.

However, this man... claims he's a "voluntary" eunuch and doesn't need one. To make matters worse, Nelly ends up shooting Go Min-Beom with an arrow of "lust" instead of "love," and struggles to prevent herself from failing the test...!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

201112.description:
On a strange, rainy night with a full moon, adult novelist Areum discovers a physical secret her childhood friend Beom-Ho has been hiding. Curious, she touches Beom-Ho's body, and a brilliant idea for her next novel strikes Areum! Ever since, whenever she's stuck on a story, she feels her writing improves when she meets Beom-Ho. To overcome her slump, she proposes a strange contract with him... but this contract also presents a golden opportunity for Beom-Ho, who has a crush on Areum!

Dan-O grew up seeing strange, inhuman things since childhood. Incidents and accidents constantly occur around him, leading to constant layoffs from his part-time jobs. This time, after receiving his layoff notice, Dan-O, now penniless and frustrated, is visited by someone who tells him to "go to Wolhae Village and claim his inheritance." Dan-O inherits a bathhouse nestled atop a mountain. But not only does he inherit Dan-O Bathhouse, he also inherits two handsome men he's never met before?! Cheong and Hyeon act as if Dan-O has always owned this place, and it's their destiny, and this only makes things more suspicious...

Dan-O Bathhouse, a place with a mysterious aura that only spirits visit! The long-standing bond between three men continues here.

Cornelia Meitner’s husband is dead. She should be celebrating her newfound freedom, but with no heir to inherit the Marquis title, she’s at risk of losing her estate and the community of staff-turned-friends. To protect her lifestyle, she has only one option: get pregnant as soon as possible. Luckily, a few eligible bachelors are visiting for Marquis Meitner’s funeral, including a dashing young doctor, a lascivious poet, and a callous duke. Who will come out on top in this game of seduction?

Hye-Ju's brother has put her in a pretty uncomfortable situation by housing his army buddy, Do-Jun, in his room until he's discharged. He swears Do-Jun is a trustworthy guy, but it's not his urges Hye-Ju is worried about. And it doesn't take long before a couple of drinks push her to confront her budding feelings.

The plots and conspiracies of the Sima Akdos target the Great Heaven, and the true nature of the human weapons is finally revealed! The world is a phantom butterfly dream. If this is a dream, may it never wake up!!

A lawless era of mountains and seas of corpses. The Geumganggong (Vajra Art) arrived just in time. Only then did peace return to the martial arts world... However, the bloodthirsty demons revealed their true colors once again. The Nine-Eight Masters, who reinterpreted the Geumganggong and perfected their dream of creating the Bloodwater Demonic Art, revealed their true colors. Who will save the blood-soaked martial arts world?

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

He who makes even ghosts tremble - Those who wish to deal with him must first remember that he is the most difficult opponent in the world. Gui-Gyeon-Su, the world's scoundrel, who leads two world-class beauties and runs wild. A story of a gangster who becomes a scoundrel and runs wild... A hero who saved the world from disaster with the status of a weeper, not an illegitimate child, but his start began with self-torture and despair. Who would have thought that a scoundrel's struggle for survival would move the world? And so... the story began...

This triggers Moeko's sudden loss of energy and ill health. While taking a day off from work to help her grandfather in the fields, she meets her classmate, Hodaka, the son of a temple priest, for the first time in a long time... She'll be living in an excruciatingly stifling world. Having been together since birth, there was naturally one thought in my mind.

While feeling a little bit of loneliness… I pushed my childhood friend (who was trying to escape with all her might with her arms still bound) towards the knight that came to pick her up.

"Alistaaaaaaaaaaaaar!!"

I feel as if there was some deep resentment in her voice, but that was probably just my imagination.

As her last act of futile resistance, she had me see her off to the royal capital… but, that ended without any problems.

"Now that that's over with, I'll be heading home. Good luck ^^"

I turned my back towards my childhood friend who looked me with deep resentment in her eyes. While I was making my way home… I had to turn around as I was chased by goblins.

"Noooooooo!! Someone, helpppppppp!!"

This is the misunderstood heroic tale of a scumbag hero and scumbag saint mutually getting in each other's way as they attempt to pursue happiness.

I quit my job and moved back home. But things will never be the same as back when I was playing around at my grandpa's when I was younger. That's because back then, I did something unbelievable...

What does "unbelievable mean, exactly? Well, I don't exactly remember. There was a tall woman, but that's the only thing I can recall. She was HUGE... but maybe that's just my memory playing tricks on me.

201190.description:
In Eden City, no one slips through the shadows quite like Gemma Steele, the infamous jewel thief. So when the determined Inspector Raven Hunt finally catches her, she expects a jail cell, not a proposal. But Raven needs her skills to retrieve a priceless royal gem, and a fake marriage is the perfect cover. Now, the city's most wanted thief and its most straightlaced officer must team up to play newlyweds. Can Gemma and Raven pull off their act without getting caught in each other's feelings?

(Source: Tapas)

201192.description:
Justice born from evil, malice born from evil.

Chae Jeong-Eun, on the verge of revenge against Kim Young-Jin, the man who had driven her mother's death and her own life into darkness, is left with no hope of achieving her goal. Her life is shattered by Young-jin's rise to power. Losing all motivation, she wanders the streets, ultimately contemplating death. Then comes the phone call from Kim Do-Gi. At Do-Gi's suggestion, Jeong-Eun joins Rainbow Taxi. After six months of training as a recall driver, she takes on the role of intern and works alongside him on recalls. Will Jeong-Eun successfully complete her internship and be hired as a full-time driver? And will Do-Gi and Jeong-Eun emerge victorious in this showdown with absolute evil? It's time to board the Model Taxi again!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

201195.description:
The main character, a young girl named Sherry, is an excellent "gatherer" who collects special herbs and magic stones. She became a gatherer to help her only relative, her younger sister Irene, a saint, but when Irene comes of age and is engaged, she abandons her and tells her to disappear somewhere. Sherry decides to leave her country and heads for the neighboring Rogue Kingdom, where magic is thriving. Along the way, she meets Aslan, a handsome magician from the Rogue Kingdom... This is the Cinderella story of a gathering nerd who turns her life around.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

201198.description:
Kim Do-Gi, the ace driver of the revenge agency "Rainbow Taxi," is brutally murdered by his family, colleagues, and lover due to the conspiracy of Park Ui-Cheol, the real owner of Rainbow Taxi. Left alone in the blaze, Do-Gi's only hope is revenge against Park Ui-Cheol... But Park Ui-Cheol has established a new company, "Rainbow T," and it's become even more powerful. Kim Do-Gi, far from seeking revenge, finds himself being hunted by Park Ui-Cheol's new taxi drivers. In a moment of peril, Do-Gi is saved by the mysterious taxi company "Doremi Taxi." He follows them to a call girl he once missed, a former colleague who had supported the Rainbow Taxi drivers. He learns that Doremi Taxi was actually a revenge agency founded by survivors who lost everything to Park Ui-Cheol. Kim Do-Gi resumes driving under a new company! A revenge even more intense than the original story begins!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

201199.description:
Despite her fiancé's infidelity just weeks before the wedding, Satinne Del Mare is forced to go through with the marriage for the sake of family ties. However, when the event is crashed by an old schoolmate, she accepts his proposal on impulse and marries him instead! After the adrenaline wears off, Satinne realizes something important she hadn't considered. Her new husband is her childhood bully! Did she just make a horrible mistake? Or will this turn out to be the marriage of her dreams?

(Source: Tapas)

201200.description:
Lee Yeon-Jo, who has dedicated her life to paying off her debts, working in bit parts, is presented with a golden opportunity: the new film by the director known as the "Princess of Cannes." Furthermore, her co-star is the coveted top star Kwak Jae-Yi. The problem lies in the bed scene. With no experience with men, and fearing that her hidden scars will be exposed, she botches her first bed scene and makes a dangerous proposition to Kwak Jae-Yi:

"Shall we sleep together?"

She deceives herself, claiming she's hoping for a flawless performance, but the offer hides a deeper truth. However, Kwak Jae-Yi, who appears gentle and gentle to the public, reveals his true nature, which is terrifying.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

My name is Woo-Min! I'm a bright-eyed middle school student. And yet, I... ended up on the street?! I slowly turned my head and our eyes met: Mimi. She wore panties on her head, handed Woomin a pair of panties, and disappeared. And so, the transfer student who appeared before Woo-Min, who had hoped his dark past would be forgotten, was Mimi?! The two met again, and panties!

"Hey, give me my panties."

201204.description:
Seo-Hyung knows that Ha-Min and Woo-Jin are dating, but wants to confirm his feelings for Ha-Min. Sol catches him trying to kiss a sleeping Ha-Min during a drinking party. Sol's Confucianism explodes and scolds Seo-Hyung, driving him to the brink of a kiss...! Seeing Seo-Hyung trembling, he advises him that he is too young to know his feelings, but Seo-Hyung's reaction is strange?!

201205.description:
"I'll secretly break up any couple you want."

Pretending to be a matchmaking agency, Kwon Ju-Ah, the team leader of a couple breaking company, tries to disrupt her ex-boyfriend's relationship! The main character, Kwon Ju-Ah, is the team leader of a matchmaking agency. On the surface, she works to bring couples together, but her main service is secretly breaking up couples - the Couple Breaking Business! Then, she receives an irresistible request to break up the relationship between her ex-boyfriend, Park Si-Hwan, and his lover, Min Ah-Yeon. She stumbles as she takes on her ex-boyfriend's request to break up their relationship, seemingly as a strategy or as revenge.

"I got you, this guy...! Just like you said in the past, I'll become the ultimate villainess!"

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

201206.description:
Born with monstrous strength, Macaron Spartan dreams of living as a proper noble lady, but her father insists she follow the warrior fate of House Spartan. Thanks to the unexpected help of a mysterious boy named Ganache, she briefly enters high society and tastes the life she longs for. However, that fragile dream fades as a dark plague spreads across the land, forcing her to wield the strength she wished to cast aside. Can Macaron save the world and still claim the gentle life she desires?

Six girls, NMIXX, embark on an adventure toward MIXXTOPIA, a world where everyone's diversity is respected. Along the way, they fall into the villain Monopol's trap, their ship catches fire, and experience numerous twists and turns. While repairing the burned ship, the girls remain in the real world, confronting prejudice and stereotypes. Meanwhile, they gather others to join them on their journey to MIXXTOPIA. Finally, the newly renovated ship, MMU, safely sets sail. NMIXX enters an ocean-like black hole to reach MIXXTOPIA.

201231.description:
Born into a ducal family, Yona was bedridden, his body ravaged by the vast magical power flowing within him. One day, he happened upon a book, one that contained the entirety of ancient magic. Among its pages was a spell: Magic to Manipulate Objects.

"If I can master this... maybe I'll be able to walk like a normal person..."

Through desperate effort, Yona succeeded in learning the magic. But soon after, a doctor informed him that he only had one year left to live. Standing on the edge of despair, Yona made a decision: as his final wish, he would set out on a journey to seek the world's legends. Yet Yona does not know, that on this journey, he will bring about miracles wherever he goes, and come to be known as a "Little Hero."

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

Shocked, Beni visits a boat race track herself and witnesses the intensity of the action for the first time. Learning that boat racing is a sport that does not discriminate between men and women, she decides to become a boat racer herself and enrolls in a training school.
However, the place she finds herself in is far more harsh than she expected...!?

Now, the corpse begins to tell the truth of the case.
It can be said that it is a common sense in the current investigation "Prosecutor" However, this way of thinking had already been implemented in the Edo period. At that time, there is a book called "Regular Recitation," which was said to be the bible of the prosecution. The genius concentricity Kitazawa Hokenjo (Kitazawa Hokentaro) who investigates this in detail in one hand and lets you tell the truth of murder with one hand. There was no one with the technique of the public prosecutor's office, and he went out to the field like him and changed Kitazawa, which examines corpses casually. Such a Kitazawa is helped by doctors and women who love doctors, Genkai, and a female painter, the moon. While they're chatting casually, the sister also ends up wearing a sailor school uniform. The brother is excited to see his sister looking different, and little by little, he can no longer hide it, and a climate of suspicion begins to form between them...

201256.description:
In 2045, extreme summer weather and A.I. automation have transformed daily life. As traditional summer culture fades away, children of this generation find themselves yearning to experience the intense heat of summers past...

201258.description:
Married off to the Domine family like a commodity, Amelia lives a loveless and dreary marriage. Unbeknownst to her, she was manipulated into spying on her own husband, ultimately meeting a tragic demise. Given a second chance at life, Amelia is determined not to repeat the same foolish existence. She makes an offer to Count Domine.

“I will help you win this war.”
“And what do you seek in return?”
“When everything is over… divorce me.”
“How come?”
“Where neither love is given nor received, why stay in such a marriage?”

Handshakes were exchanged, and with each passing step, Amelia drew closer to her liberation. But this man... was he always this sweet?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.

201354.description:
"I want you to be my wife and the mother of this child."

One day, Sapphire comes across David, a little boy with amnesia, and she takes him into her care. Despite not being a real family, they live happily together until Duke Krist Galbraith, the police chief, appears on her doorstep, claiming to be David's father. Upon seeing David's reluctance to leave Sapphire, Krist proposes marriage to her. However, Sapphire harbors a secret she cannot share with anyone. If it is revealed, not only will Krist divorce her, but she could also face immediate execution!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

201355.description:
Demia Lawrence, the daughter of a fallen baron, secretly marries her childhood friend Dyrtehen Romerby. But contrary to her expectations, her married life is filled with mental abuse from Dyrtehen and physical abuse from her mother-in-law. She becomes increasingly overdependent on Dyrtehen who, almost right after the wedding, leaves for the capital for business and doesn’t return for five years. Meanwhile, Demia discovers that her mother-in-law is plotting to assassinate her and flees from the Romerby House. After much hardship, she arrives at Evan Hasworth’s house, another childhood friend. But Evan, once a sweet boy, has grown to be a mature man seemingly hostile to her for reasons unknown…

Will Demia successfully escape the claws of Romerby and resolve the misunderstandings with Evan?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.

After the extinction of humanity, a tentacle shota boy is created by the sole surviving doctor, and in the end, he mates with the doctor until he runs out of strength.

(source: Dlsite translated)

201359.description:
One day, Angelica, the daughter of a duke, is suddenly informed by her fiance, the crown prince, that he's calling off their engagement. Since the engagement was originally ordered by the king and was unavoidable, she's totally okay with the cancellation and welcomes it! But the one thing she doesn't like is that he's blaming her for the breakup.

Just as she begins to take action to clear her name, a handsome prince from a neighboring country proposes to her! Even for someone with no romantic experience, spring has finally arrived...! But her naturally competitive nature and the rigid attitude she developed as a princess prevent her from saying "I love you" to him.

Will you still love me even though I'm like this?

Angelica's determination to prove her innocence eventually leads to a story of national salvation that puts the country's survival at stake...

(Source: Dash X Comic, translated)

201361.description:
Model Lee Hwi-Hyun is a sadly impotent virgin. One day, he meets famous photographer Jeong Mi-Eul. Her first impression is of a calm and collected person, but as soon as the shoot begins, she transforms, overwhelming Lee Hwi-Hyun like a predator hunting its prey. Perhaps due to Jeong Mi-Eul's fiery gaze enveloping his entire body, Hwi-Hyun begins to feel a growing heat within him. Jeong Mi-Eul, who has always been aroused by the camera lens, also continues to shoot in a state of intense excitement...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

201363.description: Aozawa Kanata is a first-year university student. Upon entering university, she ends up sharing a room with Ichinose Yui, the daughter of her father’s friend and a third-year student at the same university. However, once they start living together, she learns a shocking truth: Yui is a lesbian, and is known for being a notorious womanizer. This is a university roommate story about a straight junior who is seduced by a beautiful, lesbian senior.

201369.description:
Jeong-Won Yoo endures endless complaints and insults every day at a customer support call center. But one day, when the stress becomes too much, a caller’s calm, soothing voice gives him a rare moment of comfort. Certain he’ll never hear it again, Jeong-Won is stunned to recognize the same voice at a local restaurant—belonging to the kind server, Gyu-Hyeok Lee. Too shy to approach him first, Jeong-Won admires him from afar. However, he isn’t the only one who can’t stop thinking about that call.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title.romaji: Ueki no Housoku Exhibition: Fukuchi Tsubasa Tanpenshuu

201371.description:
"You saved me when I was about to break..." This popular romance novel, which gently comforts the pain of youth, has been made into a manga! Asaba, a second-year high school student, is an excellent student who excels in both her studies and club activities. However, while trying to mediate between club members, she begins to swallow her true feelings, and one day develops a condition called "adolescent prosopagnosia," which makes it impossible for her to see her own face. What's more, her classmate, Sei, finds out about this. Asaba braces herself for Sei, who speaks his mind and despises her. But Sei takes Asaba out of school... How can we soothe the suffocating everyday life that everyone feels back then, and now?

(Source: KoiYui, translated)

title.native: 青春ゲシュタルト崩壊

201372.description:
Minoru Shirashige is a short guy on his way to school. Normal train, normal commute. It's so packed that he can't even move... at least he's shoved up next to his classmate Chiyuki, whose body is big in all the right ways...

And that's when things get interesting.

(Source: Dlsite, translated)

201375.description:
Choi Woo-Ju, who has been imagining his first love for a long time because he couldn't forget it, suddenly sees his first love, Yu Hye-Sung, in front of him after 8 years. Hye-Sung expresses his interest in Woo-Ju's being a band member, and this gives Woo-Ju a chance to realize his imagination that he has always had...

The moment the stage lights turn on, all the truth is revealed?!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

201377.description:
A young lady falls into forbidden love!

God, is it "right" to go and see that person? Shiori attends an extremely prestigious school for rich girls. She took strict school rules and a regimented lifestyle for granted. "Right" or "wrong"—that was her value system. But now, she finds herself completely exposed, body and soul, by a shady freelance writer. This is strange, this isn't right. Even though she knows it, she can't stop herself... God, please tell me these feelings are "right"...

Also included: Sweet Punishment and Bitter Summer: A Secret Paradise, Having Been Here; The Uniform Dilemma: Aftermath (Newly Drawn)

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

201381.description:
A samurai and a princess have been reincarnated as the opposite gender!?

Haruna Tokiko is beautiful, capable, kind-hearted, and dignified, earning her respect from those around her. She's a modern-day woman with memories of her past life as a male samurai. One day, Mizuki Sasaoka joins the company mid-career and turns out to be the unmistakable reincarnation of the princess she adores! Tokiko is thrilled to be reunited with her beloved in this life, only to discover that her beloved princess has been reincarnated as a boy...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: この恋、お護り申し上げる

201382.description:
Ukishima Hana doesn't believe in ghosts.
As a student of science, the existence of ghosts was something she couldn't accept ー until she met that woman.
An eccentric woman showed up at the orientation for the science club Hana heads over. She introduced herself as Yotsuya Kazari and whispered: "Ghosts exist".

201384.description:
Kujou Aiko is a nationally renowned actress. Having been active in the entertainment industry since she was a child actress, she is kind, lovely, and glamorous... but behind her faint face is a terribly selfish, arrogant, and evil woman. One day, Aiko sets her sights on Shuuhei, a man who works at an advertising agency. He has a look that Aiko likes, and a wedding ring on his ring finger... seducing a married man is the most fun game for Aiko. Shuuhei and his wife, Ayano, get caught up in Aiko's flirtation, and their lives begin to go awry...!! An eccentric revenge story set in the entertainment world.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 九条愛子に、凄惨なる死を
title.romaji: Kujou Aiko ni, Seisan Naru Shi wo

201385.description:
Yuyuko is called a "cool girl" because of her mature appearance and demeanor. But in reality, she loves cute things! She tries everything she can to win over the cute teacher, Kurumi-sensei, whom she fell in love with at first sight...!?

The school's coolest girl × The sweetest high school teacher. What will become of this stubborn love story—!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Includes one-shot Shooto Shisou! (ショートしそう！)

title.native: かわいいにもほどがある！
title.romaji: Kawaii ni mo Hodo ga Aru!

201386.description:
High school students Ako and Tako share a dream of leaving their hometown of Takaoka to pursue the literary life in Tokyo—but they face more than the ordinary obstacles of small-town dreamers. For the past 10 years, Takaoka has been cut off from the rest of the world by a mysterious, ceaseless snowfall, fostering a superstition among its residents that venturing beyond means risking death. When a famous novelist suddenly arrives in town, his presence shakes up Ako and Tako’s lives, and a flurry of strange and sinister events begin to swirl around them.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

201389.description:
Top idol Zetty’s rare photocard - if Siwu doesn’t buy it now, he’ll regret it forever! After finally tracking one down, Siwu rushes to meet the seller, only to run into a little cash emergency. Hwiyeon agrees to give it up for a discount, but there’s a catch. Siwu’s gotta give it up, too…and we’re not talking about photocards here.

(Source: Lezhin US)

201390.description:
Raised under the harsh rule of an abusive father, Ju-ho has spent his life being compared to his perfect stepbrother, Hyeon-Wu. As his father’s cruelty deepens and Hyeon-Wu’s obsessive behavior grows more disturbing, Ju-Ho’s spirit begins to break. Then one day, he meets Su-Hyeok, a kind and gentle man who offers the warmth and comfort Ju-Ho has never known. For the first time, Ju-Ho finds himself relying on someone outside his family, falling into a fragile love that feels almost like salvation. But as he clings to Su-Hyeok, Hyeon-Wu’s fixation only festers. Years later, even as adults, Ju-Ho finds that the grip of his family’s twisted love and his own buried wounds are far from healed, and one lingering kiss may awaken everything he’s tried to forget.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

201391.description:
Reclusive and withdrawn, Tae-jeong has spent years shut away from the world, surviving in the quiet suffocation of his own room. But when his father is suddenly hospitalized due to a car accident, even that fragile isolation begins to crumble. Grief and fear twist together inside him, leaving only one outlet, an uneasy rush of desire that both calms and consumes him.

Enter Eun-won, the golden boy who has everything Tae-jeong doesn’t: confidence, charm, a life untouched by loneliness. He looks at Tae-jeong with disdain, pity, and something darker, an attraction he refuses to name. As the line between disgust and desire blurs, both are drawn into a dangerous intimacy born from guilt, curiosity, and longing.

What begins as comfort becomes compulsion, and behind locked doors, Tae-jeong and Eun-won learn that even the most broken hearts can crave, and destroy, in the same breath.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: アウトサイド・ザ・ドア〜お前が扉を開ける時〜

201393.description:
The protagonist, who had worked himself to the bone at the Murim Alliance, finally retires and heads back to his hometown to fulfill his dream of becoming a sect leader. Due to his meager savings, he ends up purchasing a manor that was suspiciously cheap, and rumored to be haunted. But then, an unfamiliar system suddenly appears before him. Though startled at first, the protagonist soon begins to use the system to efficiently recruit disciples and manage the sect’s finances and resources. In time, with the help of the system, his sect grows rapidly, so much that it starts drawing the attention, wariness, and hostility of other Murim factions…

(Source: Naver, translated)

201395.description:
Kana moved to Tokyo in the spring to become a university student, but somehow she couldn't fit in with the vibe of the cool city girls around her. Just when she was hoping to live a peaceful, inconspicuous university life, she somehow catches the eye of Kamishiro Setsu, a senior who is immensely popular with the girls on campus. Before she knows it, cruel rumors are spreading that she's "a girl who's after her seniors," and the misunderstandings only deepen...

Unable to bear the situation any longer, Kana blurts out her true feelings, but Kamishiro Setsu, who just so happens to be there, becomes even more interested in her...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 君はいつしか毒になる
title.romaji: Kimi wa Itsushika Doku ni Naru

201396.description:
Lisette, the eldest daughter of a Margrave family, loses her father in battle and enters into a political marriage with Victor, the prince of a neighboring country, to stop the war. However, when Victor executes her sister, Lisette loses everything and takes her own life...or so she thinks. But when she wakes up, she finds herself back in the moment when she rejected his marriage proposal! This time, she will protect her family! Even if this is a loveless marriage... But Victor's attitude towards her is a little different from his previous life...? A pure love story that begins with a political marriage and returns to life after death begins!

(Source: Pixiv Comic, translated)

title.native: その政略結婚、謹んでお受け致します。 ～二度目の人生では絶対に～

201397.description:
Noah was raised as a boy since she was born in order to take over as the heir to the Phaistos family. However, she decided to hide the fact that she is actually a woman, left the family for her younger brother's sake, and joined the army.

Noah has continued to rack up military achievements in order to become the commander of the federation army, and one day was handpicked to join Prince Johann's bodyguard squad.

The prince's bodyguard squad was made up of unique individuals that were the creme of the crop: Noah; her adopted older brother, Kai; the twins Jaden and Benjamin, Dominic, said to be the strongest soldier in the military; and the youngest, Osker. However, Johann often acts like he's not a member of the royal family and is actually a flippant flirt!

But as Noah serves Johann, she gradually comes to know how Johann actually feels...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

One day, he woke up to find himself transformed into a “tiger-eared girl”—!

Rito Momoyama is a high school boy who aspires to become a novelist, but without much success. Then one day, he develops “Beastification Syndrome.” Tiger ears and a tail sprouted, and then, for some reason, he is transformed into a girl, too? A wild, adolescent beast transformation × TS comedy!!

(Source: Comic Fuz, translated)

201399.description:
Yoshikawa, a high school girl who lives her life influenced by those around her, witnesses her class's diligent honor student, Hayasaka, taking off her uniform alone in an empty classroom...

While Yoshikawa is confused by the difference from her usual self, Hayasaka begins to take off even more of her clothes...!?

A coming-of-age yuri story that reveals the secret "me"!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

On Valentine's day, Mandie was betrayed by her boyfriend who had been dating with her for three years. That's not the worst. What's the worst is that she met Benjamin. He approached her gently, and at last they were together. After they broke up, neither of them knew each other. Until one day, Mandie passed him by hand in hand with another man.

201409.description:
“You are now the princess elect of this kingdom.”

You were just a commoner visiting the palace. But in a twist of fate, you were selected as the kingdom's princess! What awaited you was an encounter with the captain of the royal guards.

“I swear to stay by your side and protect you for the rest of my life.” A vow that the captain secretly made to you. Who will you, the princess, choose to be your prince? Nothing can break this spell—not even the midnight bells.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

201444.description:
Yutaka Aso's Children of the City is a manga published by Yodosha in 1947. It depicts two war orphans struggling to survive the postwar period, while being exposed to unreasonable violence, hunger, thirst, and prejudice. There are no lines, and the story is drawn so that the reader can understand it just by looking at the pictures.

Yutaka Aso is known as the creator of "Easygoing Daddy," which was serialized in the Hochi Shimbun newspaper in 1923 and gained popularity. As one of the founders of story-based manga, he is a manga artist whose name is sure to be found in any book on the history of Japanese manga, but there are probably very few people reading his manga these days. His postwar works have been forgotten.

This work fully demonstrates Aso's skills as a journalist and urban observer. The poignant loneliness of the two war orphans is reminiscent of later "gekiga."

201446.description: During the drafting of Chirinuru wo, Shoutarou Ishinomori's elder sister, Yoshie, passed away. This loss would affect him for the rest of his life. The confession was impulsive. Yoon's impulsive confession to Sang-Hyeok, whom he had a crush on, ended up being met with violence. Betrayed by Sang-Hyeok, whom he trusted, and made a scapegoat for the bullies, Yoon ultimately made an extreme choice...

The story of Sang-Hyeok, the model student class president who confides his true feelings in guilt, Soo-Young, the mysterious bully, and Yoon, who finds herself in a precarious position within their relationship.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

201491.description:
Kwak Eun-Ho has spent 11 years as Ji Hyeon’s friend and 7 years as his manager, all the while hiding his huge crush for him. But his secret partially comes to light when the two of them shoot a variety show called “Check Out My Manager,” and Eun-Ho drops a bombshell during the interview: “There is someone I’m interested in.” This greatly irks Hyeon, who believes there is someone in Eun-Ho’s life that he doesn’t know about. But that “someone” would have been so obvious if only Hyeon could have checked out his manager just a little more...

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: 讓我來介紹我的經紀人

201492.description:
One day, Young-Jun's younger sister So-Young falls ill with a strange illness after returning from a company retreat. To unravel the strange phenomena occurring to him, Young-Jun seeks out Do-Yeon, a distant relative with psychic powers. However, Do-Yeon pushes Young-Jun away, but something unidentifiable appears before the two. And then, one horrific incident after another befalls these two...!

Ghosts chase them, and Do-Yeon's dark past is revealed. What will be the ending for these two?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

201493.description:
Influencer Ikaruga Natsu returns to Japan from the Vatican to meet up with Mamiya Yuika, a classmate he fell in love with in elementary school. There, he meets the Vatican priests Liberio, Jiu, and Gaul, who fight against demons, and Yuika, who also fights against them... But after his face, his only good quality, is ruined by a demon, Natsu becomes embroiled in a battle with Satanists in order to regain his handsomeness and win Yuika's favor!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

He's just an old man who resists the effects of aging, but... with his unrivaled skills...?! He's super popular with the heroine...?!

An anthology comic by a group of up-and-coming authors, in which all the main characters are "old men".

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

If you want to lift your spirits, get in the car and go on a trip! Wherever you go, it'll be paradise!!

201496.description:
In his past life, Chou Sekiei was the undefeated war hero Kou Eihou—no pressure, right? Now, a thousand years later, all he wants is to get a nice, cushy job as a civil official and build a quiet life for himself. Too bad that he still has fighting prowess he can’t explain. Too bad that as a child, he was taken in by a renowned general and trained alongside Chou Hakurei, famed for her talent and beauty. Too bad that he’s gotten into rescuing pretty (and pretty immature) merchant prodigies. Sekiei was really looking forward to some peace and quiet so he could kick back and read, but when the foreign nation of Gen launches an invasion that triggers war, he’s forced to put his books down. With the power of skills he’d hoped never to put to use again, Sekiei will once more have to make a name on the battlefield... Will he and his friends be enough to save their homeland?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

201497.description:
Ok-Ji Mun can’t escape bad luck. From tripping in class to near-miss accidents, her life has always been one streak of misfortune after another. What she doesn’t realize is that her best friend, Ha-Seong Ji, is actually a Grim Reaper assigned to keep her safe. When the truth comes out, Ok-Ji learns her fate has changed and she has only 30 days left to live. A strange method might let her alter destiny, but it comes at the expense of others. As high school drama collides with a mysterious threat, Ok-Ji must decide what to do before time runs out.

(Source: WEBTOON)

After the death of Yoritomo, the Hojo clan's regent, Tsunetoki, lost his backing and married off his 16-year-old sister, Princess Hikawa, to the 7-year-old shogun. But who did his sister really love? She fell into the valley of love. Set in Kamakura, this is the story of men fighting political enemies and the women who loved them.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

Suzu, a high school student, inherited the special ability to transform into a man from her parents. However, in today's peaceful world, she has no use for it. A young British man named Crow is named by his grandfather, a Japan enthusiast. The house on the outskirts of London that his grandfather left behind is inhabited by the gods of poverty and fortune...!? A British-style tale of various gods!

The Mogami clan, a prestigious family of Oshu since the Kamakura period. This book contains five stories, including the story of the tragic princess, Princess Koma.

But one day, Akira Motokawa, the young president of Yuzuki's company, shows up at her bar. She thought he wouldn't recognize her, but somehow he saw through her right away. “Even if you can't use magic, I still love you.”

Disowned by her family for lacking magic, Yuno becomes a maid at the royal palace. There, she is assigned to serve Prince Dirk — her first love and once her only friend!?

Miori receives a cat that is said to bring happiness from a friend of her late grandfather. She then begins living with four brothers who follow the cat!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

201547.description:
Despite being a vampire, Komako is poor and easily fired from her part-time jobs. She's enjoying downtown life in Tokyo's Sumida River basin with her pet turtle. The people around her are unique and somehow strange...!? A spectacular fantasy of interspecies love!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.romaji: Kimi to Itsumademo: Tokyo Shitamachi Kyuuketsuki Monogatari

201548.description:
A masterpiece of unconventional thrillers created during the rise of gekiga. This is a complete reprint of the kashihon edition published by Wakagi Shobo in 1958. The story unfolds on an island where a boy who successfully stowed away arrives—a graveyard of shipwrecks. The boy's father, the lighthouse keeper on this island, behaves mysteriously, leading to one mystery after another as events unfold around the lighthouse. This work comes from a period when the author, drawn to works by Edogawa Ranpo, was producing masterful mysteries like “Yottsu no Hanzai” in rapid succession. It's a fascinating piece where the author's wholesome humanism and humor shine through, yet also hints at a nihilistic edge.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

201549.description:
The mind of manga artist Ryou, who cared for her mother until her death, leaps from the present to 1946, the year she was born. What will she witness before her eyes? A life of fierce battle against her toxic parents begins. How did she become the queen of mystery and suspense comics?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

201550.description:
At work, you're the cold, strict senior colleague. At home, you're the gentle, sweet lover. Which one is the real you? The extraordinary Itsuki Tsutsui debuts with a 59-page one-shot about a secret, warped obsession no one can know about!!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

201551.description:
It's spring, the first day of high school. Classmates are still a little distant from each other. Some are proactive in their interactions, some hesitate to talk, and some don't seem interested in others at first glance. There are all kinds of different human relationships.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: A JK Who Slowly Becomes Yuri

title.native: じわじわ百合になっていくJK
title.romaji: Jiwajiwa Yuri ni Natte Iku JK

201552.description:
As if it weren't enough to be born as the bastard child of a noble, Valenti meets her final demise by starving to death after being sold as a slave by her very own father in her bankrupt country. But when she wakes up again, time has been rewound to right before she was sold as a slave. From then on, Valenti vows to become the lady in waiting to the so-called monster prince, to escape her horrendous past life's fate, and to hold up the prince as the nation's true emperor for her beloved country. After graduating summa cum laude as a lady in training, she chooses not to accept the prized fate of becoming an attendant to the empress, but to the one individual nobody would want to support. But her plans become mixed up when her position as lady in waiting is challenged by... love?!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

title.romaji: Watashi wa Kaibutsu Ouji no Hisho

201553.description:
Lili, a witch who dreams of the outside world, lives quietly in the depths of the forest because she is unable to control her magical powers.

Together with Aisha, a witch whom she loves like family, Lili searches for a little "happiness" in this heartwarming fantasy set in another world!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: LiLi Witch Of The Forest Of Longing

title.romaji: LiLi Doukei no Mori no Majo

201554.description:
“I’m gonna make the funk music I love popular.” This was once Aida’s resolution, but time slipped by, leading to an ordinary career instead. Now, with each passing day, the sensation of being trapped continues to torment him. In the midst of this, a former bandmate extends an invitation. And when Aida takes up his bass guitar for the first time in a long while, sure enough, his heart trembles to the music…

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 獣のように飢えている

201555.description:
Shanghai, 1920. Amidst the unstable situation, Shion, a student engrossed in reading the newspaper, is approached by a woman. Her name is Shuliang. A military wife, she asks the cultured Shion to write a letter for her. As their words exchange, the two are drawn to each other, even as they clash at times. However, the reality that the future cannot be promised and the inevitable changes of the times painfully tear their feelings apart.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

201556.description:
“We were happy until that fateful day.” Born into a clan of apothecaries, Olive is a young girl who dreams of continuing her family’s legacy. But then, one day, her hometown gets attacked. She loses her entire family, except for her older sister. They get adopted by the lord of the domain, Earl Elvert, only to be treated like livestock. Olive does everything to protect her physically disabled sister, who’s eventually taken hostage in order to coerce Olive to abuse her power.

“It's because only your family can make a ‘perfect poison’ causing instant death.”

That is, an ability to refine a special kind of poison from her blood. Olive is forced to assume a false identity, marry and later poison the infamous ""Murderous Duke."" However, contrary to the rumors, Duke Victor seems to be an honest and kindhearted man...

“I don’t want to kill him. But as things stand, my sister...”

The more love she feels from Victor, the more her anguish grows.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

title.native: 薬師オリヴィエは愛する公爵に死を贈る
title.romaji: Yakushi Olivier wa Aisuru Koushaku ni Shi wo Okuru

201557.description:
Elisa, the daughter of the count and a priestess-in-training, was devotedly working towards the betterment of her kingdom. Despite her humble and clumsy demeanor, she lived a life of contentment and peace, cherishing what she had. However, her world was shattered when her beloved older sister, Iris, who was dispatched to the palace as a consort candidate, was unjustly framed by the despotic Queen Paris, leading to the execution of their entire family. Rescued by Prince Luka from a neighboring kingdom, Elisa plunged into despair after losing her dear family. Overwhelmed by grief, she swore to avenge her family's death and unravel the truth behind Iris's alleged treason. Elisa then adopts a new identity as Elena Porshal, the daughter of Viscount Porshal.Haunted by the question, "Why did my family have to die...?", Elena embarks on a mission to unveil the truth. She enters the castle as the king's latest consort candidate, determined to extract the truth directly from Queen Paris herself...!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

title.english: My Revenge on the Crimson Queen

201559.description:
Kobashigawa is a self-proclaimed elite salesman who ends up in a car accident one night. When he wakes up, he finds himself in the body of a girl named Elly, a chubby and unattractive girl from another world! Kobashigawa has no clue what's going on, but when he learns of Elly's misfortunate past and the precious things she's lost, he decides to live in the other world! He goes to school at a magic academy, fights monsters, diets, dresses fashionably, and creates a new business in his new world. This is a Cinderella success story with tons of interesting elements!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

title.english: Elly Golden and the Mysterious Switch

"We're not interested in conquering Aincrad! We want to open a restaurant!"

201561.description:
Nanao is a university student who can see people's negative emotions. While searching for an apartment, he is introduced to a property by a real estate agent that turns out to be a haunted property...!? Are humans scarier than ghosts?! A mystery surrounding haunted properties!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

201562.description: A one-shot published in Manga Tengoku.

201563.description:
At the suggestion of his editor, struggling manga artist Inuma is tasked with adapting a psychological horror work by the immensely popular manga artist Narita Hikaru into a comic. Inuma is impressed by the work's horrifying yet fascinating nature, and begins drawing with high hopes that it will undoubtedly become a masterpiece. However, from that day on, a series of disturbing and disgusting events begin to occur around him...

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

Galetocherdo, a fearsome serpent shark with an unexpected soft spot, falls head over fins at first sight for a rabbit statue and decides then and there that a bunny will one day become his mate. Trapped in an unfamiliar place and relentlessly courted by a forceful yet strangely sweet shark who refuses to take no for an answer, Virdo is pushed into a whirlwind of misunderstandings, identity chaos, and dangerously close proximity. As Galetocherdo demands “proof” and the line between obsession and affection blurs, Virdo must find a way to escape...or survive...this wildly inappropriate marine matchmaking.

According to the era's most scandalous bestseller, a truly great husband must be blessed with both a stunning face and a grand "package." Seo-Young, a bride-to-be, takes this advice to heart. In a bold move to vet her fiancé, she ends up asking a complete stranger—whom she mistakes for her future brother-in-law—about his brother’s size. When he suggests his own is a fair comparison, he leaves her with a tempting offer: "Meet me at the watermill tonight if you want to see for yourself." Driven by a curiosity she can’t suppress, Seo-Young steps into the shadows of the watermill, stepping into a trap of desire she never saw coming.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunae Danpyeonseon (순애 단편선) Collection.

201631.description:
“Never let anyone know you’re a shifter, Myo-hee. Especially other shifters.”

Her grandmother’s warning echoed in her head, but fate had other plans. During her final shift before a long vacation, the unthinkable happened.

“Why would you come out while in heat?”
“…What?”
“The scent is overwhelming today.”

Her heat, which she thought was days away, had suddenly struck. Driven by instinct, Myo-hee threw herself at the man before her.

“Grandmother said… I have to sleep with a man… to stop the heat…”

In that instant, the man’s patience finally snapped.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunjeong Danpyeonseon (순정 단편선) Collection.

I'm a nerd, but I have a popular guy as my pet???

Teruko spends her days hiding, trying not to get involved with anyone. But when she finds out an unexpected secret about Yozan, the most eye-catching boy in her class, she finds herself constantly getting involved...!!? A nerd girl rises to the occasion! Will love be born from this???

201641.description:
After being rejected by the girl he likes, Hariyamada Bonta, a dull college student, falls into a manhole and experiences the now-popular reincarnation into another world. He is picked up and cared for by the beautiful married elf Magnolia, but at night she suddenly asks him for creampie sex. In addition to her, he finds himself surrounded by other beautiful elves who want to impregnate him with their sperm in order to keep their village afloat! However, just when he finds happiness, a difficult fate awaits him: he is transported to another world...

Punished by the humans she ruled so oppressively, this petite tanned deity will get a taste of her just deserts!!

An ordinary woman in her 30s wakes up to find herself reincarnated as Magnolia (3 years old), the daughter of a prestigious marquis! What she thought would be a happy life in another world awaits her, but what awaits her is mistreatment from her family...and an unwanted political marriage!

201645.description:
Glaciers are melting, and the sea clans are invading. The Western gods rule over humanity, while the Huaxia people, without gods, become the target of everyone. Until a giant stone statue crosses the starry sky and crashes into the land of Jiuzhou, Zhao Feiyu comes through the void...

201646.description:
Hundreds of years ago, Emperor Molong led his demonic horde to crush every hero of this fantasy continent. In desperation, the Ximei Elf Clan activated the Noah Project, sealing away the greatest heroes and vital resources within the colossal Noah Tree.

Gu Bingjie, a delivery rider from modern Earth rushing to earn money for his mother’s medical treatment, dies in a traffic accident—and awakens in this very world. Discovering the Noah Tree, he ingeniously transforms the entire realm into a game-like system, enabling consciousnesses from Earth to be transmitted into the bodies of the sealed heroes.

Taking on the role of an NPC, Gu Bingjie issues quests and guides these “players” to build powerful city-states and forge a mighty empire—ultimately preparing them to stand against and eradicate the demonic forces once and for all.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

An obscure florist shop owner—unknown to the world—is secretly the heir of a renowned feng shui lineage. With his mother critically ill and in desperate need of money for treatment, he’s introduced to Liu Yingying, a glamorous celebrity from the entertainment industry who seeks his feng shui expertise. The entertainment world is a den of riches and intrigue—now watch as Wang Ye uses his feng shui mastery to navigate, conquer, and thrive in the cutthroat realm of showbiz!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Feng Shui Master in the Entertainment Circle

201648.description:
While working on a figure, the sculptor Tsukasa Tominaga longed for the small hands of a woman that could help improve his progress. Because he turned 30, Tsukasa then receives a "Body Remake Application" notification... It seems that recent research has allowed for humans to freely remake their bodies after the age of 30. Tsukasa gives it a shot and remakes his entire body to that of a woman's—but after going home—he finds out that his wife Subaru (30) underwent the same procedure and is now a man?! With their minds unchanged and their bodies reversed, the couple begins their second life together!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Originally published as a web comic on the author’s Twitter account and later released in print by Kadokawa on March 23, 2023, including an extra chapter.

After being unfairly crushed to death, Jiujiu ends up in the underworld, bickering with Yama. In a bid to silence her endless rambling, he reincarnates her into a novel—as a princess. But not just any princess—she’s an exiled royal trapped in the infamous Cold Palace! One day, thanks to the scheming heroine of the novel, Jiujiu’s biological father—the tyrant emperor—flies into a rage and prepares to beat her to death! Burning with fury and injustice, Jiujiu cries out in her heart: “With a cruel, ruthless tyrant completely blind to right and wrong, it’s no wonder the Western Chu Kingdom will fall in ten years! It’s a miracle it could even last that long!” To her surprise, the emperor suddenly freezes—he can hear her thoughts! With her mind exposed, has Jiujiu just sealed her fate—or changed her destiny forever?!

Sophelia Lotus is the epitome of nobility and grace, tirelessly pouring herself into her royal duties as fiancée to the crown prince. In her short fifteen years of life, she had learned, above all else, to endure. Unfortunately, however, her fiancée wasn’t quite so noble—a fact Sophelia learns firsthand when she catches him half-naked with her very own sister! Running to Sophelia’s aid is none other than Livionis, a knight of the kingdom who has long been secretly in love with her. Captivating the forlorn Sophelia at first sight, Livionis invites her to flee the kingdom and run away with him. Making up her mind in an instant, Sophelia takes Livionis’s hand and leaves behind the only life she’d ever known. Concealing her past and taking on a new identity as “Sophie,” she tumbles headfirst into a riveting romance with Livionis. With changes in tactics and the rise of new rackets, the NipponPen has almost disappeared from the international stage, and in modern times it has even been called outdated.
With that racket, the Nippon Pen, in hand, he will once again reach the top of the table tennis world! That was the dream of Asahi Ogimura, a boy who met a girl named Suzu and started playing table tennis.
However, Asahi drifted away from the world of table tennis due to a certain incident. Four years later, an encounter that makes Asahi decide to pursue his dream again...
