The Absolute is a First-Time Dad

201696.description:
As the heir to the ultra-powerful Noblisse family, Agatha has been a pawn in the emperor’s political game her whole life. He had her married off, not just once or twice, but six times! After her most recent matrimonial fiasco, Agatha seizes the chance to take control of her destiny and choose her next husband herself. Handsome, powerful, and a war hero, Enoch Aratus couldn’t be more perfect for the job. But nothing disrupts a political marriage faster than actually falling for your husband…

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: My Seventh Marriage Is About to Begin

201698.description:
College student Jisu decides to spice up a quiet night alone with a bold new idea, only for everything to go wrong at the worst possible moment. Before she can even begin to enjoy herself, the key to her shiny new handcuffs slips away and disappears beneath the closet. Trapped, flustered, and out of options, Jisu realizes there is only one person who can help her: the handsome man living next door. Swallowing her embarrassment, she heads over in desperation, setting the stage for an unexpectedly intimate encounter that neither of them saw coming.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Neighbor, Could You Please Unlock My Handcuffs?

title.native: 옆집 아저씨, 제 수갑 좀 풀어주세요
title.romaji: Yeopjip Ajeossi, Je Sugap Jom Pureojuseyo

201699.description:
My first fuck buddy was the first person I ever fell for.

Despite having zero romantic experience, Sano Kiyotaka and Aihara Tamaki accidentally met as fuck buddies on the first dating app they ever used. They fell for each other, but were convinced they'd be dumped if they didn't maintain a detached, adult attitude. Even as their bodies grew closer, they struggled to bridge the emotional distance.

A lewd yet pure, innocent yet erotic one-sided love comedy of two people who met and fucked on their first date begins!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

201700.description:
From the moment Princess Juciellia Brianna Panterin was born, she was surrounded by expectations. As the first white tiger beastkin to be born in a hundred years, she is destined to save the world from destruction. Despite growing up adored by many, Juciellia struggles with her powers and fears she may not grow strong enough to protect her loved ones. With time slipping by and calamity drawing near, will the White Tiger Princess rise to meet the hopes of all before it’s too late?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The White Tiger Princess Is Not Danger
The White Tiger Princess Isn’t Dangerous
องค์หญิงเสือขาวน่ารักเกินไปแล้ว

title.english: The White Tiger Princess Is Safe

201701.description: "Pokémon Ranger" is one of the professions in the world where Pokémon live. They protect nature and Pokémon, and solve various problems with their help. The manga showcases the exploits of these "Pokémon Rangers in a full-colored 16-pages story!
synonyms: Pokémon Ranger - Learn with a Ranger at Ise-Shima National Park

title.native: ポケモンレンジャー・レンジャーと学ぼう伊勢志摩国立公園
title.romaji: Pokémon Ranger: Ranger to Manabou Ise-Shima Kokuritsu Kouen

201702.description:
Bom is trying to move on from her first love by focusing on work and her budding new relationship with her friend, Dongwook. But something seems... off. She can’t seem to give him her heart. When her ex, Joonyoung, suddenly comes back into her life, the cracks truly begin to show. Dongwook’s affection warps into obsession. But just as Bom starts to question how things ended up like this, a mysterious camera arrives on her doorstep with the promise of magical snapshots that will reveal the truth.

(Source: Tapas)

201703.description:
Abandoning justice for the sake of justice? Ddasik's unwavering conviction that he's willing to resort to any and all brazen and lethal tactics to achieve justice. Embody the justice within his unpredictable mind!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

201704.description:
The idealistic Lee Sang-Shin and Kook Joong-Rok of the tracksuit team up again. Their superior looks, with their halos shining from their faces, are revealed! Let's delve into everything about them!

(Source: Naver, translated)

201705.description:
Hunt, Harmonize, Harvest—that’s what slow life means in this freezing snowscape!

Orphaned as a child, Vito only remembers life being raised in a cold northern village. However, that changes during his coming-of-age ceremony when he suddenly regains memories of his past life as a modern Japanese person—and finds out he’s been reincarnated to save this world! With the help of the spirit Shefi and his ““workshop,”” Vito strives to improve the lives of his fellow villagers. Before long, his reputation among the locals skyrockets—especially with Alrich, the young woman who leads the village. Thus begins an otherworldly nomadic fantasy living alongside fluffy animals in the great outdoors!

(Source: Manga UP!)

Note: Includes one extra chapters.

title.native: 転生先は北の辺境でしたが精霊のおかげでけっこう快適です ～楽園目指して狩猟開拓ときどきサウナ～
title.romaji: Tensei-saki wa Kita no Henkyou Deshita ga Seirei no Okage de Kekkou Kaiteki desu: Rakuen Mezashite Shuryou Kaitaku Tokidoki Sauna

201706.description: There was once a god created by human hands. Humans lusted after the god's flesh and blood. So, humans overthrew the god and cut off various parts of his body to keep for themselves, including his arms, legs, eyes, ears, hearts, internal organs, and even the god's xx...

title.native: 転生社畜のチート菜園　～万能スキルと便利な使い魔妖精を駆使してたら、気づけば大陸一の生産拠点ができていた～
title.romaji: Tensei Shachiku no Cheat Saien: Bannou Skill Benrina Tsukaima Yousei wo Kushi Shite tara, Kizukeba Tairiku Ichi no Seisan Kyoten ga Dekite Ita

201708.description:
A full-fledged spy adventure comic about their passionate friendship, rife with betrayal!

(Source: Naver, translated)

201709.description:
High school student Hayato Katsuragi is reincarnated as Rayvelt Runwalker, the son of an aristocrat from another world, after a traffic accident. At the time of his reincarnation, the goddess bestows upon him a cheat skill with no level limit, but at the same time, he also acquires the most dangerous skill, "One Who Has Been Struck by Difficulties." Condemned to a life on hard mode, Ray decides to undergo intensive training to become stronger. While undergoing training, he lives a happy life surrounded by his cute maid and younger sister, but then a horde of monsters invades...!?

(Source: CMOA, translated)
synonyms: The Infinite Level-up Cheat and the Deadliest Skill

title.native: 転生して成長チートを手に入れたら、最凶スキルもついたのですが！？
title.romaji: Tensei Shite Seichou Cheat wo Teni Iretara, Saikyou Skill mo Tsuita no desu ga!?

201710.description:
Aim to become the strongest with unparalleled swordsmanship and magic!! A modern-day holy knight is reincarnated in another world! A fantasy heroic tale of a fierce battle against demons with his allies!!

(Source: Comic Jardin, translated)

title.native: 転生聖騎士は二度目の人生で世界最強の魔剣士になる
title.romaji: Tensei Seikishi wa Nidome no Jinsei de Sekai Saikyou no Makenshi ni Naru

201712.description:
Heroes even stranger than the monsters themselves set out to save a city plagued by monsters.

(Source: Naver, translated)

201715.description:
A friend from college, a rather herbivore guy I'd never really thought of as a man, suddenly kissed me and confessed his feelings to me! But what should I do? It feels so good...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: トロけてもいいですか？

201716.description:
Misaki Yamazaki dies of illness—only to wake up reincarnated in the world of a manga she once read. To her horror, she’s reborn as the story’s cruel stepmother, notorious for abusing the young protagonist. Even worse, she regains her memories just one day before the wedding, leaving her no chance to escape her fate. Determined to change the story, Misaki resolves never to mistreat her new stepson. But when they finally meet… he’s unbelievably adorable! As she raises him using knowledge from her previous life, even her cold, distant husband begins to soften. For the sake of her stepson, she’s willing to use every advantage at her disposal. A unique parenting fantasy begins—changing another world’s child-rearing with the power of love and otaku knowledge!

(Source: Alpha Manga)

title.english: The Art of Being a Stepmother

201717.description:
That day, when I met you, my world, where I couldn't even speak, was filled with music.

High school student Fujieda Yuzuki is a kind girl who is liked by everyone. She prioritizes the people around her - her friends and her boyfriend - and hides her true feelings. She's not good at using her own voice. Putting others first had been Yuzuki's way of life up until then. That is, until she met you.

One day, Yuzuki comes across a girl singing and playing the guitar on the street. Unable to forget the voice, she was humming a tune alone in the classroom after school when the girl from that time, Terada Hinata, appeared. It turned out to be a student at the same high school. What's more, she spoke to him, saying, "I've come from the future to save you" --!?

A girl meets girl x school youth story!!

(Source: Young Ace Up, translated)
synonyms: With You, I Can Sing About Tomorrow

title.native: 君となら、明日を歌えるの
title.romaji: Kimi to Nara, Ashita wo Utaeru no

201718.description:
Vice seems to be just a doting father watching over his innocent daughter Pearl, but his real identity is a fantastic creature worshipped as a god from ancient times! Why is this peerlessly-powerful monster being led around by a little girl? This is a quaint yet sugar-filled daily-life story of a dad and his child.

(Source: Alpha Manga)

Notes:
- Volume 2 contains the extra "Marte no 1-nichi" (マルテの1日)
- Volume 3 contains the extra "Halloween no Kodomotachi" (ハロウィンの子供達)

201720.description:
The manga centers on the titular Lili Raspberry, who has been alone for as long as she has known, and has never known a happy day. One day, she gets the opportunity to attend Scientia, a magical school that she has long dreamed of. Here, students prepare to become wizards in order to attain a happy life. But an unforeseen incident occurs in Lili's class.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 魔法練習生 リリ・ラズベリー

201721.description: Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the web novel of the same name.

201722.description:
The final season of "Wind Beneath My Wings" follows Seo-Ha, once a servant of the divine windborn, now reincarnated as a human after being cast out of the heavens. His former master, Shane, descends to the mortal world to reclaim him. As they grow closer living side by side, their bond is shaken when Shane discovers Chang-Hee, a man from Seo-Ha’s past. Meanwhile, unrest stirs in the heavens, and with the windborn calling him back, Shane must decide: return to his divine duty, or stay with the one he's come to love.

(Source: Lezhin US)

201723.description:
In his past life, Xu Tian was the one and only ultimate villain—betrayed, ganged up on, and brutally killed by countless "chosen ones." Well, if they won’t play fair, don’t blame him for snatching everything they hold dear! Now reborn and bound to the **Interception System**, Xu Tian travels the world hijacking heaven-defying treasures, stealing fate-altering opportunities, and even recruiting those so-called "chosen ones" to farm gold for him. Leering with a devilish, minotaur-like grin, he declares:

“Your little sister is quite lovely… She’s mine now.”

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: The Villain Emperor, Intercepted the Child of Destiny
The Villainous Emperor Snatching the Destiny of the Chosen One
The Villainous Emperor: Snatching the Child of Destiny
Villainous Emperor: Snatching the Destiny of the Chosen One
Villainous Emperor: Stealing the Destiny of the Chosen One

title.native: 反派大帝，截胡天命之子
title.romaji: Fanpai Dadi, Jie Hutian Ming Zhi Zi

201724.description:
Feng Wuyou is raising a snake. It is that those of the Snake Tribe are cunning and sinister, and the lowest of the low amongst all the spiritual races. They truly aren't fit to be kept as pets! Feng Wuyou stroked her pet snake, and while smiling, she said, "Little snake has no fur! Little snake is the cutest!" Chu Feichi took her words to heart. During the day, he maintains his original form and tries to win her over. At night, he takes his human form, waiting for an opportunity to seek revenge. After repeatedly failing to get his revenge... Chu Feichi just can't do it anymore! Who on earth said that Feng Wuyou was innocent and cute instead of scheming?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: My Pet Snake Is Playing Me Again
My Pet Snake Is Toying With Me Again

title.romaji: Wo Jia She Chong You Zai Yan Wo

201725.description:
All my sect brothers and sisters are freaking reincarnated supreme powerhouses—while I’m just some random ordinary guy from a third-tier city, somehow tricked and dragged back by my master to play nanny for the whole damn sect!

Luckily, this sect is absolutely stacked with buffs—and by sheer luck, I’ve awakened the **Affection Value Codex System**!

Collect codex entries of these reincarnated powerhouses, earn their affection, and temporarily wield their insane abilities. Life’s about to get seriously OP—and ridiculously fun!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Even If You Cheat, You Are Still the Weakest in the Sect?!
Even With Cheats, Am I Still the Weakest in the Sect?!

title.romaji: Kaigua Ye Shi Zong Men Zui Ruo?!

title.native: ヒプノコントローラー
幼馴染のママは即ホテル希望
title.romaji: Osananajimi no Mama wa Soku Hotel Kibou

201733.description:
As a devoted servant of Artemis, the nymph Daphne has taken a vow of maidenhood and pledged to never give her heart to a man. However, she finds her loyalty to her goddess shaken when she meets Apollo and is instantly mesmerized, feeling things she had sworn never to feel. As Daphne falls into temptation, she finds herself helpless against the chaotic whims of the gods. Will her transgression lead to true love? Or will the consequences of breaking her vow be more severe than she ever imagined?

(Source: Tapas)

201734.description:
Jegal Hyun, the youngest team leader at a design company. With a blessed(?) personality, he's been living by nagging those around him for 32 years. One day, he's suddenly kidnapped by a UFO! Waking up in an unfamiliar place, Jegal Hyun is subjected to a "development" experiment in front of the spaceship's captain, Callisto, and the director of the research center...

"It's not like I get dizzy just from adding XX to XXX like an ambitious person! What do you think men are?"
"Me, I feel inferior?"
"I'm a man!"

Let's begin ▷▶ Female corruption experiment!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

201738.description:
Terrorists have seized the school where Kanihiro and Tenichiro study! There's only one way to escape this crisis. The zodiac fortune-telling from the morning news...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

201740.description:
In a school where eating sweets is forbidden, there's a rampant underground trade in confectionery... This school is controlled by those known as the "Snackuza" who secretly sell sweets beneath the surface...!?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: おヤクザお嬢様のおかしな抗争
title.romaji: Oyakuza Ojou-sama no Okashi na Kousou

201741.description:
During the busy lunch hour at "Ma’s Southern Southern Cuisine," a delivery order comes in. The person calling turns out to be a police officer who has feelings for Ma, and he seems to be in a desperate situation...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: Delivery of Love★Noodle, Eggs, and Rice!
title.native: 愛よ届け★メンタンハン！

201742.description:
A popular, enticing body. ❤

(Source: FAKKU)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2019-02

201743.description:
I was confessed to. It was during the summer of my first year. I ended up dating Kana. Even though I didn't understand my own feelings...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

201744.description:
Relaxing mingling in private. ❤

(Source: FAKKU)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2019-02

201745.description:
Shedding my old, reclusive shell

(Source: FAKKU)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2019-02

title.native: 叱って許して頭を撫でて〜爆乳清楚な介護士がおじさん大好きな理由〜
title.romaji: Shikatte Yurushite Atama wo Nadete: Bakunyuu Seiso na Kaigoshi ga Oji-san Daisuki na Riyuu

201747.description:
A night steeped in immorality... Let the madness begin!

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2018-01

201748.description:
A wild night without my husband...

(Source: FAKKU)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2019-02, 2019-06, and 2020-01

201749.description:
Valentina’s former fiancé appears before her, looking like a ragged vagabond and carrying a letter secretly ordering his death, sent by none other than his uncle and her future husband. Though Valentina tries to push him away, Aethelred seems intent on winning her back.

(Source: Manta)

201750.description:
Saint Flafre has been in an underground prison for many years, where her holy powers have been exploited and she has been treated cruelly, eventually losing them. The king then decides she is of no use and banishes her from the country, bearing the insults of the people. Abandoned in the wilderness, she loses consciousness and waits for death, but is saved just in the nick of time by King Forst of the neighboring country. Upon waking up, Flafre is treated well in the neighboring country and gradually regains her holy powers... This is the story of the innocent Saint Flafre, who unconsciously saves her country while enjoying farm work covered in mud.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 追放聖女のどろんこ農園生活～いつのまにか隣国を救ってしまいました～
title.romaji: Tsuihou Seijo no Doronko Nouen Seikatsu: Itsunomanika Ringoku wo Sukutte Shimaimashita

201751.description:
The title story, "Tree for Two," is a story of friendship between a girl who wants to attract attention by uprooting trees from the ground and a girl who watches over her efforts to uproot the trees. The book also includes 21 stories in total, including "Once Upon a Time," which depicts the relationship between Hanai, a girl who embarrasses herself on graduation day, and Matsukawa, a classmate who sneers at her.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

201752.description: One day, while on the beach with her parents, Fumiha finds a strange machine she takes home with her; at home she discovers that the machine she picked up can transform into anything she thinks of, but she soon discovers the dark side of that ability...
synonyms: The Machine that Came from the Sea

201753.description:
In the Magic Realm, mages train hard to master their arts. However, one mage named Toya Osoegawa only cares about using magic to live a comfortable life! But now, thanks to the orders from the Divine Magus, the least motivated man in the Magic Realm has been sent to the Human Realm! Can he use his bizarre magic to protect humans and send evil wizards back to their world?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note:
- Includes the one-shot "Tonari no Osoegawa"
- Includes the one-shot "Takadai no Gekkousou"

201754.description:
Naata is a retelling of the native creationist story of Naata, whose body served as the base for all good crops.

1. Naata (ナータ)
2-6. Io: Henshin (イオ （変身）)
7-8. Dora: Aru Yameru Shoujo no Yume (ドラ （ある病める少女の夢）)
synonyms: ドラ （ある病める少女の夢）

201755.description:
What lengths would you go for a fallen friend? When the bitter soldier Chui mysteriously finds himself sent back in time, he rushes off to save his sworn brother and comrade-in-arms, Hu Yurang. But when he arrives at Yurang's house, he discovers that his sworn brother... is actually a girl. Now, Chui's out to protect her from dangerous foes (and suitors) using a spear and the terrifying demonic arts from his past life. Can Chui change Yurang's fate, or are these two destined for death once more?

(Source: Tapas)

201756.description:
Aspiring manga artist Mitsuka Konari accepts the editor-in-chief's offer to work as an assistant for the wildly popular and handsome mangaka Taru Okita. Determined to seize this opportunity, Mitsuka gears up for the challenge. However, working as Okita's assistant comes with one crucial condition—!? She can't be his assistant unless she ◯◯!? The start of a manga assistant life full of “firsts”!

(Source: Takecomic, translated)

title.native: 未経験の私がアシですか!?
title.romaji: Mikeiken no Watashi ga Ashi desuka!?

201757.description:
Minamino Momoko is a regular middle schooler, although with a few problems of her own: her overprotective father, her hypochondriac mother, school, studying; she's sick of them all!
One day, after having a dream about being eaten by cat people, she decides to skip school; she goes into a nearby café and there she meets with a mysterious lady who reveals herself to be...

(Source: https://bpojhc.hungry.jp/rippuu/cattown.html)

201758.description:
Four old friends get together for the first time in a long time to talk about the speed of light and the flow of time, reminiscing about the light they shot at the moon as children and their futures. The book includes 11 other stories: "ATOMS FEELING," "Autumn Pageant," "River," "Memories of Seto," "Toilet Next to the North Building Art Preparation Room," "Current Location," "Footbridge/Boy," "On the Street," "KEEP THINKING," and "K-kun."

(Source: Natalie, translated)

201759.description:
Goho Tsukumo runs a jack-of-all-trades business. Non-human "things" come to him as clients. They don't pay money as a fee, but rather their own stories. While responding to the things' requests, Tsukumo collects their memories and experiences as "stories" in an attempt to complete something. All in the name of bringing back the friend who once saved him.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters

title.native: 刀剣乱舞ＯＮＬＩＮＥ　アンソロジーコミック　極
title.romaji: Touken Ranbu ONLINE: Anthology Comic - Kiwame

title.native: 世界平和のために勇者と魔王をくっつけます
title.romaji: Sekai Heiwa no Tame ni Yuusha to Maou wo Kuttsukemasu

title.native: カーテンの向こう、君の声と
title.romaji: Curtain no Mukou, Kimi no Koe to

title.native: ツッパリ探偵怪人メルヘン心中

201770.description:
I was reincarnated as Blanca, a villainess in the world of an otome game that I loved in my previous life. It's unfortunate that I was reincarnated as Blanca, a character I don't like very much, but maybe I can witness a flirtatious scene between the heroine and her capture target without being charged for money! In order to make the love of the captured target and heroine more exciting than the game, I will do my best to be mean to the heroine, but for some reason the love doesn't seem to be progressing... The villainous daughter's all-out love comedy finally begins!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

201771.description:
I won't hold back anymore. My gentle yet slightly cruel childhood friend holds me so sweetly that I feel like I'm going to melt...

Sarasa is working as an apprentice at a kimono draper shop, a business that her childhood friend Takao is in line to inherit. Maybe it's because there's a seven-year age gap, but Takao is very sweet and kind to Sarasa. While Sarasa had grown up fortunate, she was worried about her future and couldn't stop worrying about it. One day, when she was considering going to study at a different shop, Takao misunderstood and thought that she was going to leave forever... so he suddenly kissed her!

This is the life of a couple who are childhood friends with an age gap, but are devoted to each other and have a passionate relationship!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Young Master is Toying with My Body!
title.native: 若旦那の過保護な盲愛 年の差幼馴染はウブな身体を翻弄する
title.romaji: Wakadanna no Kahogo na Mouai Toshi no Sa Osananajimi wa Ubu na Karada wo Honrou suru

201772.description:
Rhodri arrives at the elven forest, but it's been overrun by elf-hunting humans! Though an elf himself, he possesses unparalleled worldly wisdom and negotiation skills. But are Rhodri's weapons truly intended for fighting humans...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

201773.description:
At my high school, everyone fears Haimiya-senpai. With her sharp piercings, striking grey wolf-cut, and that brutally honest Kansai dialect, she has a reputation for being downright terrifying. Yet, for some mysterious reason...this intimidating upperclassman is kind and gentle only to me! The curtain rises upon this heart-fluttering romantic comedy about a terrifying-yet-sweet senpai!

(Source: Manga UP!)
201773.hashtag: #灰宮先輩 #灰宮先輩は怖くてかわいい
synonyms: Haimiya Senpai is Scary but Cute

title.native: 灰宮先輩は怖くてかわいい

201774.description:
A slightly precocious girl named Ramie and her dad star in this comedy manga. While it might seem like a slice-of-life story about a girl her age, the content ranges from slightly dark humor to niche interests. This collection also features other enchantingly charming girls, making it a slightly fantastical comedy anthology.

(Source: Amazon)

201776.description:
This is the story of a protagonist who wants to act manly in front of his cute first girlfriend,
but is captivated by his "cuteness❤" and is
completely overwhelmed by the protagonist's girlfriend, who melts him to pieces.

Will he be able to show his manly side?

(Source: Dlsite translated)

title.native: 先輩のかっこいいお射精 見せてください❤ -小さくてふわふわな後輩彼女のあまあまないじわるであまえんぼマゾにされちゃう話-
title.romaji: Senpai no Kakkoii Oshasei Misete Kudasai ❤: Chiisakute Fuwafuwa na Kouhai Kanojo no Amaama na Ijiwaru de Amaenbo Mazo ni Sarechau Hanashi

synonyms: WE WERE REINCARNATED INTO A WORLD OVERRUN BY MONSTERS, BUT IT'S NO BIG DEAL!! BECAUSE GOD GAVE US A MYSTERIOUS DECK OF CARDS THAT ENABLE INCREDIBLE TRANSFORMATIONS!! SO WE'RE GOING TO WORK TOGETHER TO TRY AND SAVE THIS WORLD: THE MANGA

title.native: 転生した先はモンスターがはびこる絶望の異世界だった!?でも心配無用!!神様からもらった不思議なカードで大変身!!俺たち二人で異世界を救ってみせるぜ!!な件について
title.romaji: Tensei Shita Saki wa Monster ga Habikoru Zetsubou no Isekai Datta!? Demo Shinpai Muyou!! Kami-sama kara Moratta Fushigi na Card de Dai Henshin!! Ore-tachi Futari de Isekai wo Sukutte Miseru ze!! Na Kudan ni Tsuite

201778.description:
*This book is a re-edited version of "Muscle Fairy Tales: Reading Protein," originally published in 2023, with new illustrations added. What if the characters from well-known fairy tales and folk tales were muscular?! Cinderella, Urashima Taro, Little Red Riding Hood... A short manga in which muscles solve everything.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 全てを筋肉で解決する童話
title.romaji: Subete wo Kinniku de Kaiketsu Suru Douwa

201779.description:
Oen is a young girl who is taken in by Saisenji Temple, where funerals are held for the dead. Despite her strange fate, she grows up bravely… Based on the popular work by historical novelist Kaoru Takada, this refreshing yet solemn period drama depicts an Edo-period mortician known as "Sanmai Hijiri" and the Japanese view of life and death!!

(Source: Akita Shoten, machine translated)
synonyms: 落合螢~出世花 其之二~

201780.description:
O-Ine was born in the late Edo period as the daughter of Philipp Franz von Siebold. This is a powerful historical tale that depicts the life of O-Ine, who broke through the barriers of her time and became Japan's first female obstetrician...!!

(Source: Elegance Eve, machine translated)

Note: Based on a musical by Kensuke Yokouchi about the life of Kusumoto Ine.

201783.description:
In order to rebel, Jiu Jin sneaked into the marriage team from the Western Regions to the Central Plains, and her identity was exposed on the first day. But what is gratifying is that the marriage princess seems to be a fake? For their own purposes, the two relied on each other while being hunted by multiple forces. In close contact, they gradually developed a love for each other.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

AVごっこ2 〜クソガキチ◯ポに堕ちる巨乳人妻〜

201785.description:
While the noble ladies of Tianxuan Kingdom engage in mere political struggles, Mu Qingmeng, a hostage from an enemy nation, faces additional bloody national and familial hatred. To protect herself, she navigates the power struggles of the harem, forced to scheme against the seemingly fair and benevolent Song Xinghe for temporary protection. Unexpectedly, in this precarious daily life, Song Xinghe's gentleness and kindness become her only salvation. Thus, Mu Qingmeng encounters something more terrifying than death.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: Through the Starry River, a Boat Filled With Pure Dreams

201786.description:
Xiang Wan, who travels from ancient times to the modern era, enters the voice acting industry on the advice of Yu Zhou, who takes her in. Here, she meets Chao Xin, a gentle yet resilient senior. Starting with a chance invitation, the two grow closer and develop more ambiguous feelings for each other.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

201810.description:
Shoutarou Tokitou, a university student, shares a room with his childhood friend Rin Kazama. When they were kids, the two of them went everywhere and did everything together. Shoutarou was always overprotective of Rin, who always followed him around, but after they started living together, Rin's attitude became cold and he started playing around with women... Before he knew it, a gap had formed between the two of them. One day, they got into an argument after Rin brought a woman into the house without permission, and in the process, Rin hit his head and lost all memory of their relationship. The two decided to continue living together as before for the sake of his treatment, but Rin is still as attached to Shoutarou as in the past... but seems to have ulterior motives...!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: Nice to Meet You, My Best Friend

title.native: はじめまして、オレの親友

201811.description:
A spy has infiltrated the office of a member of Japan’s House of Representatives. Nagumo, the representative’s secretary, hires the genius hacker Mio to identify the spy. Mio completes the job in record time, but he doesn’t want money for a job well done. He wants Nagumo’s body. So begins a relationship between a single-mindedly devoted hacker and a brutally ambitious political operative.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: 君なしで生きてゆく人生に価値など
title.romaji: Kimi Nashi de Ikiteyuku Jinsei ni Kachi nado

201818.description:
Tsurunosuke is a boy whose father was killed in a vendetta. Wasuke, the owner of a konnyaku shop in Tenma, Osaka, takes him in and makes him an apprentice. As the boy resolves to live as a merchant, a turbulent fate sweeps in…! This is the complete manga adaptation of an early period drama masterpiece by the popular historical fiction writer Kaoru Takada!!

(Source: Akita Shoten, machine translated)

Note: Based on the novel of the same name by Kaoru Takada.

synonyms: Cuando nos despedimos de las bicicletas

201820.description:
He's mean, but... so sweet she can't refuse him - Nazuna is a high school girl who has a crush on Kamijo, a serious and kind high school boy. But Kamijo's true face is that of an arrogant, sadistic host!? When Nazuna finds out his secret, he steals her first kiss and even does something naughty...!? Even though she should be embarrassed and reluctant, she wants to know more about Kamijo. Maybe he actually likes her a little...? Just when she thinks that, Kamijo calls her his "favorite toy"...!? The true identity of the plain boy from her class is an arrogant host!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 嘘つきな初恋～王子様はドSホスト～
title.romaji: Usotsuki na Hatsukoi: Ouji-sama wa Do S Host

201821.description:
After dying from overwork, a woman is reincarnated as April Salt, a minor character forced to serve the demanding princess. Doomed to another life of endless labor, her fate changes when she is accidentally kidnapped by the undeniably handsome Grand Duke Kaian Braille. Instead of dying again, she is confined in luxury, with every need met. What should be a prison starts feeling like paradise. If only everyone would stop bothering her and let her do nothing!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: ひきこもりは優雅な監禁ライフを守りたい
Though I’m a Homebody, I Found Myself in a Dark Captive Genre
The Recluse Who Awoke in a Story of Captivity
I’m a Homebody, But I Transmigrated into an Abusive Confinement Story
I used to be a homebody, and I ended up trapped in a cruel world

title.english: I'm a Homebody, but I Transmigrated Into a Dark Captivity Novel

201823.description: Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the web novel of the same name.

201824.description:
Inside a mysterious book, Edelise glimpses her future — dying by the Emperor’s blade. Determined to change her fate, she enlists Ruhan, a gladiator and the book’s sole key figure, as her protector. But by a twist of fate, Ruhan becomes the very Emperor she’s trying to escape, his obsession only just beginning.

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: I Want a Divorce, Please Stop Obsessing Over Me!
Don’t Be Obsessed, Let’s Get a Divorce!

title.english: Stop Obsessing Over Me, I Want a Divorce!

201825.description:
Despite his kind face and good reputation, Ha-Yun's hobby are one-night stands. One day, he becomes captivated by Seo-Jin, a new member of his club, and decides to try sleeping with him. Contrary to his thuggish appearance, with his tanned skin, muscular build, and bright yellow hair, Seo-Jin is the epitome of innocence. Ha-Yun manages to break through his innocence and have a one-night stand with him, but the next day, he tries to sort things out...

"I agreed because I like you, hyung."

"This is my first time dating."

How can he get this out of his head...?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
synonyms: The outside and inside are so different

201826.description:
One day, a statuesquely handsome man named Hyuk-Jin, who claims to be the president of the company where his father worked, visits Da-Ram, who lost his parents at a young age and lives alone in the countryside. He offers to take Da-Ram away, claiming it was Da-Ram's father's last request. A bewildered Da-Ram refuses, claiming he can't trust him. Hyuk-Jin then proposes a one-week cohabitation.

"Please give me a chance."

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

201827.description:
The wizard Elma Ruskan has a beloved lover and disciple, Muska. Facing his final exam at the Wizards' Association this year due to unstable magic, Muska proposes to Elma, offering to live together in another country after the exam. Elma hesitates, and Muska asks him to answer after the exam, heading to the capital. However, all he receives in return is his cold left arm. Muska dies mysteriously, and his body disintegrates into various magical artifacts, which are then scattered. Elma makes a pact with Malo in exchange for half of his soul and half of his internal organs, hoping to reclaim the body of his lover, who has become a magical artifact.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

201828.description:
Ethan, who grew up in an orphanage, is suddenly visited by a mysterious woman. She offers him a large sum of money and takes him to the Black Mansion, offering him to transcribe the Bible. Trembling with fear about the mansion's ominous rumors, Ethan encounters the mansion's owner, Leo. The moment their eyes meet, he is overcome by a familiar yet unfamiliar emotion. Feeling a strange sensation, Ethan tries to dismiss it, but that night, he encounters the mansion's owner, consumed by lust. A strange mansion, a series of unfamiliar emotions and strange events, and its suspicious owner. Will Ethan be able to complete his mission and return safely?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title.native: 柊先輩パンパンパンパン
title.romaji: Hiiragi Senpai Pan Pan Pan Pan

201830.description:
Yun-Woo, whom he met as a guest. His first impression was so striking that it was memorable. He suddenly said, "Please be the model for my novel." But those words were only the beginning. Yun-Woo had another motive, and Sae-Byeok, unable to even utter a single word of refusal, found himself deeply entangled in his world. And finally, Yun-Woo's hidden identity was revealed—

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title.native: ぎゃるばす・あれるぎー!
わたしはなんにも悪くない

201833.description:
Hioki somehow gets invited to join a group of four good-looking guys for a school trip. Though initially riddled with anxiety, it turned out to be surprisingly fun, largely thanks to Watarai, who goes out of his way to look after him. Just as Hioki began to open his heart to Watarai, what emerged was not simple kindness—but obsession.

(Source: Starts Publishing, translated)
201833.hashtag: #修学旅行で仲良くないグループに入りました
synonyms: School Trip: Joined a Group I'm Not Close to

title.native: 修学旅行で仲良くないグループに入りました
title.romaji: Shuugakuryokou de Nakayokunai Group ni Hairimashita

201834.description:
Ji-Woo, the owner of a car center and former racing car mechanic, has a strange regular customer who visits his shop after closing time: Bin, a former race car driver and former teammate. Ever since, Bin, who has had a crush on Ji-Woo, has a penchant for womanizing, and on race days, he uses the pretext of relieving his post-race excitement by having passionate sex with Ji-Woo at his car center. One day, Ji-Woo, who has been waiting for Bin, begins to feel resentful that Bin only satisfies his desires and then leaves without a trace, and the desire to torment her by having sex with her begins to sprout.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

201835.description:
A newly appointed site supervisor is particularly rude to a female heavy equipment operator. Despite this obvious trick, the men on site defend the driver. In reality, the driver is a seasoned veteran, respected by the men, and a powerful figure on the site. The supervisor, seeking to gain their approval but instead incurring their wrath, becomes even more ashamed and wants to kick the driver out. While everyone else is away for an after-work party, he corners the driver and, when they're alone, crosses the line by engaging in sexual contact. He stages a situation bordering on attempted rape, thinking he's won, but then realizes something is amiss...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

201836.description:
Yoo-Chan, a basketball player known for his impenetrable personality, is once the team's ace. He's unable to avoid the sophomore jinx, struggling with poor performance and falling into a slump. Taking advantage of his weakness, Hana, the cheerleading team leader, offers to help.

"Yoo-Chan, do you know that?"
"What?"
"They say if you have sex with me, your performance will improve."

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

201837.description:
No-Won, the CEO of a successful IT company, is known for his casual romances and playful attitude, but he's a scandal maker who doesn't cultivate deep relationships. When No-Won becomes embroiled in a business lawsuit, he meets Yeo Do-Young, the opposing attorney, in court. Yeo Do-Young is a cool-headed and rational, capable lawyer. She thoroughly corners No-Won and his company in court, securing a victory. During this process, No-Won becomes deeply intrigued by Yeo Do-Young for a simple reason: "That face is my style." Ultimately, No-Won signs a personal legal consultation contract with Yeo Do-Young, hoping to gain access to her. He then repeatedly visits her office, making excuses and disrupting her work. Yeo Do-Young treats him coldly, ignoring his tiresome projects. Ultimately, Yeo Do-Young makes the biggest mistake of her life, trying to get rid of him...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

201838.description:
Sae has longed for her own home and finally gets it, moving to a seaside town. However, that night, her house burns down. Sae is at a loss, but her neighbor Katsuragi reaches out to her. Sae is 30 years old, Katsuragi is 50. The two, with a 20-year age difference, begin living together. A heartwarming, slow-paced love story about the age gap!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 海辺の町で間借り暮らし

201839.description:
The anonymously known genius photographer, Spacey, has never revealed her face, but her photos have always captivated the world. Influencer Kang In-Young, who has always been the subject of gossip due to her scandalous private life, has actually been a longtime admirer of hers. In-Young, who enjoys one-night stands, ends up spending the night with a woman on this cruise as well. She thought it would just be a passing one-night stand... but it turns out it was Spacey?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: Do It Until We Get Off
Let's Keep Going Until We Get Off

201840.description:
"Pat me, Master! I've been a good boy!"

The "dog" that Rita Lowe Weltz, the Supplies Magic Supervisor, was entrusted with by her superiors was a "big man clad in the uniform of a high-ranking officer"! A capable soldier who overwhelmed enemy nations with his fierce fighting spirit, he had been cursed with the desire to become a pet dog and be loved by his master, and there was no end in sight for the curse to be lifted. Rita was stunned when her superiors handed her a large, dark green dog collar. It seems to have been woven with advanced magic that makes the "big man clad in the uniform" appear as a "dog" to everyone except her, Rita. I see, so there's no problem treating "him" like a dog... No, no, no, no, that's wrong. Everything's wrong. The collar. The collar. Um, could you please stop looking at him with those innocent, hopeful eyes? Is that impossible because it's a curse? But I still want to ask. Did I have enough vice to force myself upon a grown man who said with a straight face, "I want to be your pet dog"?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: うちの犬はもっと可愛かった　愛犬閣下は甘やかされたい
title.romaji: Uchi no Inu wa Motto Kawaikatta: Aiken Kakka wa Amayakasaretai

201841.description:
Sorako is a girl who has trouble expressing her emotions. One day, she encounters the ukulele.

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

201842.description:
Having offended his class counselor, Zhao Yan was faced with the problem of impending punishment. At that moment, the Swapping Lives Club System was activated for him. Zhao Yan entered the system’s club lobby and thus began his journey of swapping lives with members of all levels within the club. By helping his swap partners resolve their life problems and realize their dreams, Zhao Yan forges his way, step by step, into a bright and dazzling future.

(Source: WebComics)

201844.description:
Five hundred years have passed since Mu-Jin began praying for the lost souls' ascension. Then, his lover, Geum-Ji, who died 300 years ago, appeared before him, reincarnated. However, she was already dead in this life. Unaware of her own death, she returned to Mu-Jin.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Never Once Did You Touch Me Like This

201845.description:
Overcoming the past and finding happiness with a new family. A heartwarming story of love and reversal that begins with a reunion with the hero!! It has been 10 years since Rose married into the Pendleton Earl family. Even though her husband has repeatedly cheated on her, she has worked hard every day to protect her only son. However, even these days reach their limit. This is a family story filled with the love of her family who cherish her, and the wife who decides to divorce thanks to a reunion with an old friend, and the heartwarming love that follows.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 奥様に捨てられた伯爵様～虐げられてきた奥様は、思い切りよく第二の人生に向かいます！～
title.romaji: Oku-sama ni Suterareta Hakushaku-sama: Shiitagerarete Kita Okusama wa, Omoikiri Yoku Daini no Jinsei ni Mukaimasu!

201846.description: Note: Based on a musical by Kensuke Yokouchi about the life of Hiraga Gennai, who is known as Japan's Leonardo da Vinci.

title.native: 奇想天外★歌舞音曲劇 げんない

201848.description:
"I want you," he asks, but you shouldn't respond. Because you and I live in different worlds. Yuu (29) lost her job and home due to her parents' debt. Soaked in the rain with nowhere to go, she despairs at her own misery. Then, Takatsukasa Akira, the cold-hearted managing director of a business partner known for his coolness, reaches out to her. He also saves her from debt collectors...

"I'm just an employee of a business partner, so why did he do all this for me...?"

Later, she's scouted by the company where he works as managing director, offering exceptional benefits! And what's more, she ends up living with him during her probationary period!? At first, she thinks of him as a business partner and a benefactor, but as she spends time with Takatsukasa, she begins to want him to rely on her...

(Source: CLLENN, translated)

title.native: 魔王様の長すぎる初恋～冷徹御曹司との甘い契約生活～
title.romaji: Maou-sama no Naga Sugiru Hatsukoi: Reitetsu Onzoushi to no Amai Keiyaku Seikatsu

201849.description:
Ame, a young girl, moves with her father from Tokyo to the countryside deep in the mountains. It's inconvenient, there are unpleasant people at her elementary school, there are a lot of bugs, and she just wants to go back to Tokyo... But then, Ame meets a spice ghost who calls himself "Habanero"...? Her encounter with the talkative spices, which only Ame can see, transforms her boring everyday life into something exciting! The magic that can change the world with just one shake is called Spice!!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title.native: 雨とおしゃべりな香辛料

201850.description:
I want to see your cute face. I want to mess you up even more and ruin you. Who would have thought I'd have these feelings for a male colleague...?! A secret, role-swapped love affair in the office☆

Aoyama, the hard-working accounting department employee, once again criticizes Aoi for incomplete documents today. He's right, but the way he says it is infuriating! But maybe if she becomes friends with Aoyama, it will be easier to work with the accounting department? Aoi attends the accounting department drinking party with ulterior motives, but ends up discovering Aoyama's surprising side...!?

(Source: Cmoa Comics, translated)
synonyms: The Secret Face Only I Know

title.english: The Secret Face Only I Know
title.native: 青山くんはあの顔がカワイイ
title.romaji: Aoyama-kun wa Ano Kao ga Kawaii

201854.description:
Miyuki, a girl who bought a pair of mysterious binoculars from a shady antique store, gets angry and thinks that the binoculars, which do nothing, are fake. Just when she was about to stop her occult-tinged observations, there was a black figure flying in the sky at the end of the binoculars!? Miyuki was so shocked that she lost her composure. However, as a result of this, a major incident that involves the school occurs!

Note: Volume 1 includes the one-shot Shirei no Ejiki (死霊のえじき), an adaption of George Romero's movie Day of the dead. Volume 2 includes Zombio Shirei no Tatari (ゾンバイオ死霊のしたたり), an adaption of Stuart Gordon's movie Re-animator

title.native: トライアングル・ハイスクール

201855.description:
Two childhood friends share a bus ride in silence. Can they learn to talk to each other again?

Shunpei lives in a rural town in the middle of nowhere. His class has been together every year since they started school until one classmate, An, leaves to attend a private junior high. But Shunpei still sees An every day on the bus to their remote neighborhood. After years of drifting apart, Shunpei and An finally start talking again.

On the bus, Shunpei spends his time dozing off while An spends her time studying. The disappearance of a local vending machine sparks a conversation, and the pair break their silence for the first time in years! After several awkward attempts at conversation, they fall into a new routine of bus-ride banter. Can their old friendship be renewed? And could this be the start of something more?

(Source: VIZ Media)

201856.description:
A very loose adaptation of the classic Super Famicom/SNES video game of the same name.

Umihara Kawase must contend with a sinister organisation and confront the legacy of her oceanographer father with the help of her new friend Kouichi Shioji.

Note: Serialised in Comic Burger in 1995, it ran for eight chapters. Only the first six were collected in tankobon format.

201857.description:
"Who stole my husband?"

Mahoro Inoue, 29 years old, married. Surrounded by her three friends and her husband, she had everything to lead a happy life. Or at least, she was supposed to...
synonyms: My Friend Is Having an Affair With My Husband

title.native: 親友の不倫相手は、夫でした
title.romaji: Shinyuu no Furin Aite wa, Otto deshita

title.native: たたりが恐怖の学校に！！
title.romaji: Tatari ga Kyoufu no Gakkou ni!!

201859.description:
Old man Gen, who lives alone in a church on the outskirts of the village, is a cantankerous eccentric. He meets Youko, a girl who says she’s been all alone since her mother died. After taking Youko in, Gen finds new joy in his life. But one night, he notices that Youko has gone out alone. The following night, when he follows her, he finds her at the edge of Death’s Marsh—a place plagued by accidents—where she is meeting her mother, who was supposed to be dead. Gen realizes that this is not a living being; in fact, it is the Grim Reaper.

(Source: Kaiki Manga no Anagura, translated)

title.romaji: Shijin Numa ni Yuurei Shoujo ga!!

201860.description:
Fraulina, a highborn and beautiful young woman, never thought she’d live past childhood. Her incurable illness made her as good as dead… until she was miraculously saved by the genius mage, Reynold. It was that moment she fell in love with Reynold and pledged to marry him! Ten years later, at the age of 18, Fraulina is determined to marry Reynold. There’s just one small problem… Reynold has been banished from the kingdom and completely lost his will to live! Fraulina barges into the situation, determined to save Reynold, and soon enough, Reynold’s life has been turned completely upside down by Fraulina’s incredible abilities and infectious personality. This is how Fraulina and Reynold, banished and living at the edge of the world, begin their roller coaster of a married life!

(Source: SMA)
synonyms: The All-Powerful Lady Fraulina Rosenheim Won’t Rest Until the Banished Mage Marries Her!

title.native: 最強公爵令嬢の辺境おしかけ婚 フラウリーナ・ローゼンハイムは運命の追放魔導師に嫁ぎたい
title.romaji: Saikyou Koshaku Reijou no Henkyou Oshikakekon Fraulina Rosenheim wa Unmei no Tsuihou Madoushi ni Totsugitai

201862.description:
Risa Ito, who considers herself an urban manga artist, actually grew up deep in the mountains! Food, vehicles, events, dialects, customs, Jomon pottery... The strongest Deep Japan is here! A heart-wrenching autobiographical comic brought to you by "Native Countryside" Risa!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

201863.description:
Asaria, the daughter of the Spencer family, one of the four great ducal families, has her engagement broken off by the Crown Prince, Louis, and is then framed as a "wicked woman of the ages" by his mistress, Saint Orine, and executed. In the agony of her dying moments, Asaria suddenly finds herself transported back in time to two years ago. This is when she decides to live life to the fullest, this time as herself, and to enjoy life as a wicked woman. This is the story of a vengeful girl who experiences love and friendship for the first time in her second life!!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 脇役の公爵令嬢は回帰し、本物の悪女となり嗤い歩む
title.romaji: Wakiyaku no Koushaku Reijou wa Kaikishi, Honmono no Akujo Tonari Warai Ayumu

201864.description:
Elaina was a queen who died a tragic death in her previous life. In this life, she was born as the illegitimate daughter of a certain nobleman, and although she was treated coldly, she was relieved that she could live without attracting attention. However, one day, her hidden magical powers were discovered by Asuno, a handsome genius knight... A chase love romance between the most powerful young lady who lived a quiet life and the deceitful knight king!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 私はただの侍女ですので　 ひっそり暮らしたいのに、騎士王様が逃がしてくれません
title.romaji: Watashi wa Tada no Jijo desu node Hissori Kurashitai no ni, Kishi Ousama ga Nigashite Kuremasen

201867.description:
Peace and nature are the only things Se-Yeon expects to enjoy while staying in the countryside with a family she knows. So she's startled when she runs into the family's son, Jeong-Wook, who was her childhood friend. The two of them haven't seen each other since drifting apart in their teens, but that doesn't stop Se-Yeon from checking out Jeong-Wook's pecs. Once they catch each other in some suggestive situations, things heat up quickly between them. When the aloof Jeong-Wook suddenly confesses his feelings, it's up to Se-Yeon to decide where to take their secret fling in the orchard...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

201870.description:
“Mira, you are the true saint,” said Prince Al with a gentle smile. But I’m only pretending to be a saint for the sake of revenge…!?

Falsely accused and executed, Mira was reincarnated as a princess of a neighboring empire. However, her peaceful days were short-lived—an invasion by an enemy nation stole away her homeland and her parents, and separated her from her brother. Even at the village church where she drifted to, she was treated coldly for lacking the powers of a “saint.”

One day, the coldhearted prince of the enemy nation, Alphaus, arrives in the village. A crisis looms with the approach of magical beasts…

title.native: 捨てられ転生皇女ですが敵国で聖女のフリをしています
title.romaji: Suterare Tensei Koujo desu ga Tekikoku de Seijo no Furi wo Shiteimasu

201872.description:
It was late at night. The old-fashioned doorbell echoed through the run-down building, ringing on and on. Worried the noise might disturb the neighbors, Jee Heejin carefully opened the front door to see what was going on.

“Who is it…?”

“Hey… long time no see.”

Jee Hee-Jin and Jee Hyun-Woo, who once lived as step-siblings for five years after their parents’ remarriage, meet again after five years apart. Now a handsome medical student returning in triumph, Hyun-Woo approaches the drunken Hee-Jin and whispers that this time, they should become family not as siblings, but as husband and wife… and in this forbidden reunion, Hee-Jin is forced to make a life-altering choice.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Ji Hee-Jin and Ji Hyun-Woo Meet Again

title.romaji: Ji Hui-Jin-gwa Ji Hyeon-U-neun Dasi Mannaseo

201874.description: Note: Part of Playtoon's Play Danpyeonseon (플래이 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: The Young Master Wants to Devour the Maid!
The Maid Wants to Be Devoured by the Young Masters

201876.description:
Haedam was always special among humans for being unafraid of the hybrids who are vaulted as higher-class citizens. Perhaps it was her desperation to make money for her sick sister that allowed her to work for Sahyuk the snake hybrid for so many years. Regardless of the reason, Sahyuk has only become more fascinated with his servant and his feelings have only grown more carnal.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Gyeryak Danpyeonseon (계략 단편선) Collection.

201880.description:
Nielis Glarelle wakes up as the feared witch in a revenge novel. Once revered for her magic, she met her end after unleashing destruction on those who exploited her. Given a second chance, she grows weary of hatred and chooses a peaceful, carefree life. Her plans fall apart, however, when she saves Harvey Augusta, the very paladin who killed her. A moment of pity becomes a lifetime of chaos, and now she has one burning question: Why is the once cold and ruthless Harvey so clingy in this life?!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 育てた聖騎士に執着されています
The Reborn Witch Raises a Templar

title.native: 转生魔女养成了圣殿骑士
title.romaji: Zhuansheng Monu Yangcheng Le Shengdian Qishi

201881.description:
Reincarnated as a green-eyed brunette in the novel "The Murderer Targets Brunettes", Selenia knows that the murderer in question will be arrested within a year. To avoid being murdered herself, she holes herself up in her room until her adoptive father betrays her and has her sent to the mage tower. To her surprise, the master of the tower is Eon de Grandnoir, the very murderer she's trying to avoid! The tower is staffed entirely by green-eyed brunettes, who seemingly work there of their own free will. Can Selenia survive and solve the mystery in the process?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: 殺人鬼、褐色髪の令嬢を狙う
ฆาตกรร้ายหมายหัวคุณหนูผมน้ำตาล

201882.description:
One is a policeman who suddenly opens Yin-yang eyes (eyes that can see ghosts which ordinary people can't see). The other is a pet shop owner who is born into a spiritual family but is powerless. The two unexpectedly involve in a monster rampage incident and their cooperation is noticed by the the special affairs section. Since then, the two start their fantastic career of monster hunting.

(Source: WebComics)

201883.description:
In turbulent Shanghai, the domineering young marshal meets his ex-lover. He hopes to get back together with her, only to be involved in one conspiracy after another. Warfare, revenge, love and hatred, happiness and sadness... At this time of turmoil, can their hard-won love be secured?

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Wo De Zongcai Jiushi Zheme Meng

201884.description:
Human greed is endless, and we repeat the same mistakes...? We're opening up reviews of the truly great items you'll want to use for a lifetime, and the truly bad items you'll want to immediately return. We're sharing the stories of characters in the works and the whirlwind impulse purchases of our writers!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Stories Included:
1. Kwinpaemilli(nim)ui Jeonhwareul Badeusigetseumnikka? (퀸패밀리(님)의 전화를 받으시겠습니까?) [Beombae]

15. Dokgeonochonggagui Got'em! (독거노총각의 갓템!) [Kun-Seu Seo]
16. Jeonseorui Jakga Sansamui Geumdanjiseo Jingwibon! (전설의 작가 산삼의 금단지서 진귀본!) [Sansam]
17. Han Yi-Yeon-ui Chungdonggumae Huimangpyeon (한이연의 충동구매 희망편) [Eun-Jae Lee]
18. Nae Kkumeun Neoya.. Subak-Ka. (내 꿈은 너야..수박카.) [Lady Watermelon]

201885.description:
"Would my friends have felt regret or envy as they watched me suddenly transfer to Seoul?"

Shin-Bi, a neighborhood resident who's lived in the same place for 17 years, is forced to leave her beloved neighborhood and move to Seoul when her older brother, Shin-Hye, transfers to a preparatory school. Leaving her familiar surroundings and encountering new people...

Shin-Bi, who has never met anyone before, yearns for her old neighborhood. Will she be able to navigate this sudden shift in her mindset? A tumultuous coming-of-age story of high school students on the brink of adulthood!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

201888.description:
In this life, I will never give up on my dream of becoming an actor!

"Stop being a jerk and tell your parents you want a divorce. I'll give you alimony so you don't feel bad about it."

Se-Ah discovers her husband Ji-Man's affair with her friend Yu-Ri. What's worse, she discovers the shocking truth that the very people who forced her to give up her acting dream eight years ago were her father and husband.

"Because of that scandal, I had no choice but to quit acting...!"

Despairing over her miserable reality, she walks along a rainy road and gets into an accident. When she opens her eyes, she finds herself back in the audition hall from 10 years ago...?!

"[Gift Me to Me] was great. See you next time."

"I also want to act with Se-Ah."

Furthermore, unlike her previous life, Se-Ah, who is devoted to acting, keeps being approached by actor Do Gun-Ha, her previous scandal partner before her return... A rookie actress in her second life, Se-Ah, and top star Gun-Ha, their entertainment industry romance, both skilled in acting and romance! Skillfully for the Second Time!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Second Time, Like a Pro

201889.description:
Ferlina is married to the ruthless Emperor Vald as a hostage to secure peace. However, an incident leads to her being possessed by an adorable stuffed animal Then, when the Emperor discovers her true form, she finds herself in dire straits -- or so you think... She wakes up in the form of a stuffed animal!?

A heartwarming fantasy that's sure to soothe you!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 冷酷皇帝は人質王女を溺愛中 なぜかぬいぐるみになって抱かれています
title.romaji: Reikoku Koutei wa Hitojichi Oujo wo Dekiai-chuu Naze ka Nuigurumi ni natte Dakareteimasu

title.native: 冷酷皇帝は人質王女を溺愛中 なぜかぬいぐるみになって抱かれています
title.romaji: Reikoku Koutei wa Hitojichi Oujo wo Dekiai-chuu Naze ka Nuigurumi ni natte Dakareteimasu

synonyms: Pretending to Be a Spring Breeze

201893.description:
A boy of superhuman beauty, Urokoboshi Ao, transfers to second-year high school student Tsuchiya Chikage's class... Or so it seems. Urokoboshi is actually an alien! He scatters stardust from the corners of his eyes with every blink, causes electrical appliances to malfunction with radio interference, and physically floats when he falls asleep! And for some reason, he's become attached to Chikage, expressing his affection honestly every day...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

201894.description:
The monk Kouta was planning to die. Born into a temple, Kouta was handsome and from a wealthy family. He'd lived an easy life without any complaints. But the other day, he was told he only had a short time left to live, and he decided to give up on the world and die. But then the angel Pin-chan suddenly appeared and declared, "I've come to save Kouta!" Kouta decides how to die, and the angel decides how Kouta should live. As the two return home, their battle unfolds, only to discover buried gold coins from a robbery in the garden...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

201895.description:
Hanamori, who works at a sports apparel manufacturer, is troubled by her own personality: overly sensitive, jack-of-all-trades, master of none, and a people-pleaser. Igarashi, a colleague who is cold and unkind to everyone, is the complete opposite of her... or so she thought, but then one day, he started to pursue her with full-blown doting affection!?

It seems Igarashi's feelings for people are either "zero" or "100."

In a conference room alone, in a cramped elevator, under the table at a drinking party... Igarashi's 100% love, unabashedly expressed without hesitation, has Hanamori at her mercy once again...!

A polarizing colleague and a troubled people-pleaser - an office romance that erupts in an instant!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ゼロかヒャクかの五十嵐くん

201896.description:
"With the stroke of my brush, I will erase one strange phenomenon and show you."

The time is the Heian period. Azusako, who lost her mother at a young age, begins her service at the Imperial Court as a new lady-in-waiting. However, because she can see supernatural beings, she is nicknamed "Mysterious Princess" behind her back and becomes the subject of unsavory rumors. Azusako wants to remain in the dark, but by chance, she catches the eye of Mitsukage, a handsome nobleman trusted by the Emperor, and ends up helping him investigate strange incidents occurring in the Imperial Court!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 宮中は噂のたえない職場にて
title.romaji: Kyuuchuu wa Uwasa no Taenai Shokuba Nite

201897.description: Saya, a tired woman in her 30s, is suddenly transported to another world. She is taken in by a group of handsome dragon knights, and as a special gift for being transported there, she becomes the caretaker of fluffy dragons with her God Hand. She strokes the dragons, massages the knights, and is grateful for every little bit of help she receives... Isn't this world just too good for a 30-year-old ?! Surrounded by fluffy dragons and handsome knights, she begins a soothing life in another world!
synonyms: Otsukare Around 30 wa Isekai de Mofumofu Dragon to Kishi no Sewa wo Shiteimasu
Tired Thirty-Something Caring for Fluffy Dragons in Another World

title.native: お疲れアラサーは異世界でもふもふドラゴンと騎士の世話をしています
title.romaji: Otsukare Arasa wa Isekai de Mofu Mofu Dragon to Kishi no Sewa wo Shite Imasu

title.native: 悪女と呼ばれた私、転生先でも悪役です
title.romaji: Akujo to Yobareta Watashi, Tensei-saki demo Akuyaku desu

201900.description:
"It turns out that Liliya still hasn't done it !" Geeky four-eyed Ai's "good luck charm condom" is picked up by the wild girl, Liliya Tanaka. Expecting to be teased, Ai is surprised to be asked, "You've got experience, right?" What's the startling request that comes from this...!? Is this the blessed, debauched school life of Ai, the lecherous, somewhat experienced girl!?

(Source: Renta)

title.english: True Love That Starts with a Lie
title.native: うそからはじまるほんとのあい
title.romaji: Uso kara Hajimaru Honto no Ai

201901.description: A special manga included in the Sakura no Uta 10th Anniversary Special Booklet.

title.native: 夢見る花火　空高く。　夢見る魚　海深く
title.romaji: Yumemiru Hanabi, Sora Takaku. Yumemiru Sakana, Umi Fukaku

201902.description: A 26 year old woman lives a high school life limited to afterschool

201904.description:
"Stocks are basically the same as sex."

A miraculous second chance at life is granted to Chan-Uk, once the king of Wall Street. So-Ra, who had bragged about her rookie stock skills in front of him, ends up losing everything she owns. Left with nothing, she offers the one last thing she has to the man she despised more than anyone.

"H-Hey... would you... buy me?"

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)

201905.description:
Ru-Min is an acting prodigy with a Newtube channel that often goes viral. As it happens, she is also the spitting image of her favorite A-list actor Ha-Jin Jeong. A shocking turn of events reveals that Ha-Jin is actually Ru-Min’s biological father. The cold-hearted actor reluctantly takes her in, but pointedly vows no affection. However, as Ru-Min’s raw talent shines, Ha-Jin finds himself becoming an unlikely mentor. Having long fantasized about Ha-Jin being her father, can Ru-Min finally make her dreams a reality?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: I Became a Top Actor's Daughter

201906.description:
Hee-seo was on the fast track to success - until her luck took a sudden nosedive. Her shaman grandmother insists it’s because her yin energy is too strong, and the only cure is to find a man with powerful yang energy to balance it out. Hee-seo laughs off the superstitious advice…until the night she meets Gong Tae-su, the charismatic head of the planning team whose energy feels almost dangerously magnetic. One unexpected encounter later, her world starts to spin out of control - along with her heart. Maybe Grandma was right, after all…

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Pas de sexe, pas de chance
ถ้าไม่ XX งานไม่รอดแน่

201907.description:
Hayami Tatsuki has had a crush on the elf Rydia since he was a child.

It all started when, as an adult, she came to him for advice...

"If you don't mind, would you make love to me?"

Since then, Tatsuki has been visiting Rydia's house regularly.
To satisfy her growing sexual desires, and of course, to help her, the woman he admires...

But before long, these acts, which were intended to release his sexual desires, begin to change after one word...!?

(Source: DLsite, Translated)

title.native: むっちりデカ乳エルフのおばさんとあの日交わしたスケベでエッチな約束
title.romaji: Mucchiri Dekachichi Elf no Oba-san to Ano Hi Kawashita Sukebe de Ecchi na Yakusoku

title.native: エルフの養母～愛するママとエッチなしきたり～
title.romaji: Elf no Youbo: Aisuru Mama to Ecchi na Shikitari

201909.description:
Giriko Kirigiri is a typical office lady just eating to get through each day. Join her as she reviews her struggle meals. These gourmet creations push the limits of food to the extreme, so don’t go trying them at home!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note: Originally self-published, was then licensed by Shueisha for serialization.
synonyms: OL Kirigiri Giriko At Her Limit

title.english: The Struggle is Real with Giriko Kirigiri!

201911.description:
What would you wish for if God granted you a wish? Chisaki wishes to know everything so that's what she asks.
Unbeknownst to her at the time, it'd have terrible consequences...

The first entry in the infamous God Series web manga.

title.native: ふつうの軽音部 出張特別編

201913.description:
In the shadows of the world, “Mages” operate in secret. They wage daily battles over “Magic Quartz,” the source of their magical powers, and now, wagering the workshops that produce the highest-quality quartz, they have begun a “Magic War (Black Arts)” at a certain academy.

Sankurou, a boy born to a mage father but lacking any magical talent dislikes the world of mages. However, he somehow finds himself caught up in this war alongside his childhood friend Neneko. Former friends and teachers revealing their true natures become enemies, and he must struggle to survive. Can he protect Neneko, an ordinary girl unaware of the magical conflict?

A school-based magical battle royale filled with ambition and conspiracy is about to begin!

(Source: Kadokawa translated)

201915.description:
“Babuba, Babubabubabubabu!?” (Am I going to be a baby!?)

Tot, a legendary assassin in the underworld, was sold by her parents at a young age and was raised strictly as a killer, so she never knew the love of a family she lacked. Suddenly, she saves a cat and dies, but after his death, she’s destined for hell for taking countless lives. However, because of one good deed —saving a cat— she's allowed to be reincarnated and is born again as a royal princess, Patricia.

Then, God commands her to save the royal family—her family. She was supposed to be reborn as a helpless baby, but her assassin skills haven’t faded, and she continues to battle killers one by one. Gradually, feelings of wanting to protect the royal family members who love each other unconditionally just because they are family...?

(Source: Jump TOON, translated)
synonyms: The Legendary Assassin Reincarnated as the Beloved Youngest Daughter of a Royal Family

title.native: 伝説の暗殺者、転生したら王家の愛され末娘になってしまいまして。
title.romaji: Densetsu no Ansatsusha, Tensei Shitara Ouke no Aisare Suemusume ni Natte Shimaimashite

2. Yume ni Omoyuran (夢にも思ゆらん)

2. Gojuunen Go no Koibito (五十年後の恋人)
3. Houko (這子)
4. Akai Tsume (赤い爪)

7. Sabishiku nai Kedo II: Tooriame (寂しくないけど　II　通り雨)
8. Sabishiku nai Kedo III: Juunen Okure no Valentine (寂しくないけど　III　十年遅れのバレンタイン)

201920.description:
Ssapcho, the owner of boundless charm that seems to flow in all directions, has made an emergency landing on Naver Webtoon! Shouting, "Even a hollow laugh is a laugh!", Ssapcho, a hard-working writer of this era, finds fun even in the harsh and difficult daily life, and embarks on a journey into the life of Ssapcho, who somehow manages to roll on!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: ซับโชสู้โว้ย!

title.native: 私立ミヤ小パパ活クラブ
せんせーオフパコしませんか？
強精入院～退院するまで100人のナースに射精管理されてます～
title.romaji: Kyousei Nyuuin: Taiin suru made 100-nin no Nurse ni Shasei Kanri Saretemasu

201928.description:
Amelia, the daughter of a marquis who has been working hard to train to become a crown princess, is told by her fiance, the crown prince, that she has met her soulmate. What's more, he wants her to become a concubine and push the duties of the crown princess onto Amelia, since he will make his "soulmate" the crown princess! Wanting to amicably avoid being used, Amelia plans to marry Loire, a magician who became a hero after saving his country from a difficult situation in war, as a reward. When she speaks to him directly, he says, "Try your best to woo me," and the negotiations are successful! Aiming for a loving contract marriage, she begins to visit Loire, but...!?

A doting love fantasy between a troubled magician and an earnest young lady ♡

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: 약혼자의 측실로 이용되느니 마법사님의 포상이 되겠어요
When the Bride is Replaced, She Chooses Her Own Fate!

title.native: 婚約者に側妃として利用されるくらいなら魔術師様の褒賞となります
title.romaji: Konyakusha ni Sokuhi to shite Riyou Sareru kurai nara Majutsushi-sama no Houshou to narimasu

title.native: 久々に会った姪がクソ生意気に成長していた件
title.romaji: Hisabisa ni Atta Mei ga Kuso Namaiki ni Seichou shite ita Ken

synonyms: Jimoto no Mujikaku Dosukebe Kyonyuu JK ni Seikyouiku
地元の無自覚どすけべ巨乳JKに性教育

201931.description:
Amelia, the daughter of a marquis who has been working hard to train to become a crown princess, is told by her fiance, the crown prince, that she has met the man of her destiny. What's more, he wants her to become the crown princess and be a concubine, so it seems he's trying to push the duties of the crown princess onto her! Wanting to amicably avoid being used, Amelia plans to marry Loire, a magician who became a hero after saving his country from a difficult situation in war, as a reward. When she speaks to him directly, he says, "Try your best to woo me," and the negotiations are successful! Aiming for a loving contract marriage, she begins to visit Loire, but...!?

A doting love fantasy between a troubled magician and a serious young lady ♡

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 婚約者に側妃として利用されるくらいなら魔術師様の褒賞となります
title.romaji: Konyakusha ni Sokuhi to shite Riyou Sareru kurai nara Majutsushi-sama no Houshou to narimasu

201932.description:
A broke, exhausted Jin-Yeon accepts a secret role — becoming the double of a dead woman who looks just like her for a man who refuses to move on. What starts as a temporary performance soon turns into addictive illusion... But when love is built on a lie, how long can it survive?

(Source: Manta)

201933.description:
Kim Do-Yun finally moved in with his lifelong crush, Seo Yi-Hwan, but a supernatural blunder ruins everything. After a freak accident, the soul of the provocative idol Yi-On takes over Yi-Hwan’s body. To get his best friend back, Do-Yun must help Yi-On satisfy a hunger for physical energy that is anything but innocent. Caught between his desperate loyalty to Yi-Hwan and Yi-on’s dangerous provocations, Do-Yun enters a high-stakes game where the lines of love and lust become dangerously blurred.

(Source: Lezhin US)

201934.description:
Raised in poverty, Kim Woo-Joon has done every kind of job imaginable just to survive. When he rushes back to his rural hometown after hearing about his mother’s car accident, he is crushed by the impossible weight of hospital bills and daily expenses. Desperate, Woo-Joon stumbles into an interview at a luxurious hotel hidden deep in the countryside, a place that caters to the ultra rich and keeps its most exclusive guests in sealed off VIP rooms. There, he meets the enigmatic owner, Kang Ra-Han, a man whose calm smile hides dangerous intentions. Instead of an ordinary job offer, Ra-Han presents Woo-Joon with a startling contract, one that blurs the line between employment and something far more intimate.

With his mother’s life on the line and no other options left, Woo-Joon must decide how much of himself he is willing to give up in exchange for survival.

(Source: Lezhin US)

201935.description:
After waking from a long slumber, the vampire Isle discovers his home has been taken, leaving him with nowhere to go. Taken in by Loan, he puts his extraordinary talent for identifying counterfeit wine to use, while slowly recovering fragments of a past he thought was lost. As his memories resurface and their unequal relationship deepens, desire, power, and fate begin to intertwine in ways neither of them expected.

(Source: Lezhin US)

201936.description:
Kim Gong-Hui, the protagonist, is summoned to another world and becomes a sacrifice to the Dragon King. To return to her original world, she needs the help of those who summoned her. In exchange for finding them, the Dragon King offers Kim Gong-Hui a contract marriage... A whimsical, comedic romance unfolding in another world!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: What I See, It Became a Sacrifice!

201937.description:
Lin Ziluo was reborn and returned to the day before the apocalypse game was about to descend, betrayed by his girlfriend, bonded the “apocalypse game cheat system”, got the 100% item drop rate, and embarked on the road of revenge!

But… this apocalypse seems to be different from what he thought…?

title.native: 末日降临：百倍爆率刀刀爆物资
title.romaji: Mori Jianglin: Baibei Bao Lu Dao Dao Bao Wuzi

201938.description:
I became a disciple of the strongest!

Chaos began to invade the world. One day, a gate suddenly appeared in the world, and monsters poured out. Humanity stood on the brink of destruction. The world of martial arts, "Eun," the world of magic and knights, "Einheart," and the world of the demons, "Gehenna," were connected, and superhumans swept away the monsters. However, they were not righteous saviors. They persecuted the newly created "players" of Earth under the law of the strong. Lee Ro-Woon sought to bring peace to the world by coordinating the players with superhumans from other worlds. Due to the betrayal of his colleagues and the superhumans from other worlds who disliked his actions, Lee Ro-Woon lost everything, becoming a wreck and falling into the abyss. Just when he was about to give up, he was transported to a sealed world as a vessel of chaos, where he encountered three absolute powers. Lee Ro-Woon became the disciple of the Three Kings and reigned supreme over all!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

201939.description: That night, she was out there having fun, trying to erase the pain caused by her cheating boyfriend, but ended up having a one-night stand with a young successful CEO. “I’ll find you, damn girl, no matter what it takes!” But the boss wasn’t very happy about what she did the next morning. Five years later, she went home from abroad with her adorable twins. On her first day at work, she found the CEO kinda familiar… (Source: WebComics)
synonyms: The Apple of the Big Shot's Eye

title.english: On the Tip of My Heart

201940.description:
"Everyone should just be 'saba saba' like me!" Nami Amihama (age 28) works in the editorial department for a women's fashion magazine. Nami constantly uses being saba saba (aka blunt) as an excuse for her biased assertions and has been ostracized by her coworkers because of it. One day, when Nami was being her usual arrogant self, she is confronted by her antithesis, Mai Honda (age 26). Mai is beautiful and feminine, and Nami can't hide her irritation. The battle between the self-proclaimed saba saba woman vs. the true saba saba woman begins!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: ワタシってサバサバしてるから

201941.description:
Despite suffering constant harassment from her senior colleagues and the parents of her students, kindergarten teacher Hana lives a happy life with her son and caring husband. As the harassment persists, however, Hana feels that she may be reaching her breaking point. Around the same time, strange incidents begin to occur around her. Those who inflict harm on Hana are suddenly disappeared, and the culprit behind these incidents might just be her adorable student Ryuuichirou, who desires Hana's hand in marriage. Will Ryuuichirou's deranged love for his married teacher lead to tragedy?

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)
synonyms: Ryuu-kun's Psychopathic Courtship: I'll Make You My Wife

title.native: 竜くんのサイコな求愛 ～お嫁さんにしてあげる～
title.romaji: Ryuu-kun no Psycho na Kyuuai: Oyome-san ni Shiteageru

title.native: 爆発！宇宙クマさん タータ・ベア＆菊千代くん
title.romaji: Bakuhatsu! Uchuu Kuma-san Taata Bear & Kikuchiyo-kun

2. Mayonaka no Binetsu (真夜中に微熱)
3. Stella no Kidou (ステラの軌道)
4. Aimai Gallop (あいまいギャロップ)
5. Watashi no Prêt-à-Porter (私のプレタポルテ)
6-7. Azufareo no Sobayounin: Bangai-hen (蒼竜の側用人 番外編)

title.native: 少女アフタースクール　―千歳四季短編集―

1. Kavallaris no Tsubasa (カヴァラリスの翼)
2. Rinneru Pallette (輪廻るパレット)

4. Dakara Kiss Shite (だからキスして)

title.romaji: Kavallaris no Tsubasa: Chitose Shiki Tanpenshuu
