title.romaji: Dorahiyo: Isekai no Ryuu wa Watashi no Nadenade ni Yowai Mitai desu

201947.description:
1. Nandemo nai Nikki (なんでもない日記)
2-9. Magical Lucy (マジカル ルシィ)
10. Magical Lucy Gaiden (マジカル ルシィ外伝)
11. St. Michael no Junan (St　ミカエル号の受難)
12. Ayakashi Saka Ibun (あやかし坂異聞)
13. Yoru ga Kowai (夜がこわい)
14. CONTACT
15. 40-nen no Kessan (40年の決算)
16. Soko ni Tomoya ga Ireba (そこに知世がいれば)

201949.description:
"Correctional officer, please help me."

Taehui confesses to the correctional officer about being molested by the leader for a week. The correctional officer, who had been listening silently with cold eyes, opens his mouth...

"Take off your clothes and show me. Proof that your breasts were sucked."

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: I Wish We Could Do It in Prison
It’d Be Nice to Do It in Prison

201950.description:
The Death of Little Bee, the last three parts of the trilogy. The characters, background, and group name have nothing to do with reality. The story of cartoonist ‘1208’.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

201951.description:
The police want to identify suspects in violent incidents. Although we are trying to secure new recruits for people captured on CCTV I was struggling because I lacked clues. Then, through the fashion community, through an investigator's idea. I wanted to find a clue in the criminal's clothes. In this process, he asks Young-Il and J for help.

(Source: Kakao Webtoon, translated)

201952.description:
Han Jichan was built to rule, effortlessly taking every privilege life had to offer while his useless brother faltered. Yet success without a challenge has only left him numb. That changes the moment Jichan finishes another round of damage control for his brother and crosses paths with Park Suhyeok. Marked by adversity and fiercely rebellious, Suhyeok resists the aura of control that usually makes everyone bow to Jichan. Drawn to the one person he cannot easily break, Jichan drags Suhyeok into an unforgiving web of control, testing how far love and hate can overlap before everything burns down.

(Source: Lezhin US)

201953.description:
Oushiki Toori is a passionate and energetic manga editor. One day, Toru, a manga artist she has been pursuing for years, invites her to meet for the first time. Oushiki is excited, but just before the meeting, she learns that Toru has posted on social media about quitting being a manga artist...!?

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

title.native: 舌噛んだときと大体いっしょ
title.romaji: Shita Kanda Toki to Daitai Issho

201955.description:
Inquisitive glances will make her fall...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2024-07

201956.description:
Wanna know more about these pleasurable things. ♥♥

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2024-05

201957.description:
A stoic warrior's hidden side...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2024-09

201958.description:
My compatibility... is beyond question. ♥♥

(Source: FakKu!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2024-11

201959.description:
They really exist (?) A naughty story... ♥

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2025-02

title.english: The Reason She Comes to My Place
title.native: 彼女がウチに来る理由
title.romaji: Kanojo ga Uchi ni Kuru Riyuu

201960.description:
Put that prankster witch in her place!

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2025-07

title.native: ドキドキは止まらない！

201963.description:
1. Kedamono-tachi wa Mori no Naka（ケダモノたちは森の中）
2. Warui Majutsu no Tsukaikata（わるい魔術の使い方）
3. Gibo Elf ni Aisaresugite Bouken ni Deraremasen! （義母エルフに愛されすぎて冒険に出られません!）
4. Zoku Gibo Elf ni Aisaresugite Bouken ni Deraremasen! （続・義母エルフに愛されすぎて冒険に出られません!）
5. Kojirase Majo wo Toubatsu Seyo! （こじらせ魔女を討伐セヨ!）
6. Kamisama no Iu Toori? （かみさまの言うとおり?）
synonyms: ケダモノたちは森の中
Gibo Elf ni Aisaresugite Bouken ni Deraremasen!
義母エルフに愛されすぎて冒険に出られません!
こじらせ魔女を討伐セヨ!
かみさまの言うとおり?

title.native: こんな世界でナニすんの!?
title.romaji: Konna Sekai de Nani Sun no!?

201964.description:
A child born to become a shaman with the fate of putting the world in chaos. To let go of his greed and refuse god, he's trying to become an ordinary office worker. Choi Yeonghoon, the one who can see destiny through physiognomy (face fortune reading) and fortune telling. Will he succeed in becoming an ordinary office worker?

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: คนออฟฟิศนี้โหงวเฮ้งดีนะครับ

201965.description:
Three modern-day girls are reincarnated into the heroines of popular fairy tales! Can this savvy Snow White survive the schemes of her evil stepmother with the help of a suspicious hunter? Can the little mermaid win her first love's heart and prevent herself from turning into sea-foam? And will Cinderella be forced to marry a twisted prince and lose her happily-ever-after? Follow our heroines as they try to survive their new chance at life!

(Source: Viz Media)

1–2. Tensei Shirayukihime wa Dokuringo wo Tabetakunai (転生白雪姫は毒リンゴを食べたくない); Cheese! 11-2020 & 12-2020
3–4. Tensei Ningyo Hime wa Awa ni Natte Kietakunai (転生人魚姫は泡になって消えたくない); Cheese! 07-2021 & 08-2021
5. Tensei Cinderella wa Glass no Kutsu wo Hakitakunai (転生シンデレラはガラスの靴を履きたくない); Cheese! 08-2025
synonyms: La cenicienta reencarnada no quiere usar zapatos de cristal

title.english: No Glass Slippers for Me: Reincarnated Cinderella
title.native: 転生シンデレラはガラスの靴を履きたくない ～アンソロジーコミック～
title.romaji: Tensei Cinderella wa Glass no Kutsu wo Hakitakunai: Anthology Comic

201967.description:
Earth has fallen in love?! An unprecedented romance unfolds across the universe! Earth, determined to break its 4.5 billion-year-long solitary existence, reveals itself to humanity. But Earth's unrequited love interest is none other than the moon?! For the sake of peace for all life on Earth, a thrilling and dangerous mission begins for humans to connect them by any means necessary!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: チェイス・ユア・ハート

201969.description:
Jang Hui-Mun, who runs a cafe with his mother in the quiet countryside village of Sanbom, is troubled by his mother's sudden employment of a shabby man. Hui-Mun, constantly entangled with this slightly flawed man, resolves to kick him out, but strangely, his lower half finds himself drawn back to him...!

A slightly wild, slightly murderous romance begins!

(Source: Boomtoon, translated)

201970.description:
In a world where polluted rain falls endlessly, a young girl lives under the protection of an artificial life form boy. One day, they venture out on a shopping trip to a distant town amidst the rain...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

201971.description:
Nana is an impressionable little girl who is infatuated with magical girls; one day, she meets God, who grants her one wish, so she wishes to become a magical girl.
Her decision may sounds like a dream come true, but it comes with dreary conditions...

The second entry in the infamous God Series web manga.

201972.description:
Tokita confesses to the boy she likes one day, only to be rejected for having a high-pitched voice.
Heartbroken, she curses God and wishes time would just stop; at the same moment God appears and grants her wish.
Now, with the ability to stop time, what will be of her?

The third entry in the infamous God Series web manga.

synonyms: サンチャゴ -レベリオン・シマバラ-

title.native: SANTIAGO―レベリオン・シマバラ―

201976.description:
A monstrous creature suddenly appears in the midst of an ordinary day, and around it, the students begin to transform into monsters one by one. Ordinariness is completely shattered, and rescue seems impossible. The students band together and survive in their own unique ways.

(Source: Naver, translated)

201977.description:
Futaba Kurumi’s life has been pretty uneventful since the day she was born.

However, when she runs into her classmate, Ryuuzaki Leo, on her way home from school, Kurumi’s simple ordinary life is turned completely upside down.

Were her eyes just deceiving her, or did Leo really just someone’s blood?!

Startled by this newfound information, Kurumi is forced to become Leo’s food, or risk losing her life to this mysterious creature.

What’ll happen to Kurumi now that she knows Leo’s secret? Will things really end up as bad as she’s anticipating? Or, will there be more to Leo than what meets the eye?

Note: Won a special encouragement award at the 102nd Newcomer Manga Award.

201978.description:
Childhood friends Ju-Hyeok and Su-Ah once promised to stay together forever, but when their secondary genders manifest in reverse, their worlds drift apart. Years later, Ju-Hyeok’s dream of Olympic gold is on the line, and Su-Ah might be the only one who can help him reach it. What follows is a story of fate, pride, and a love that refuses to yield.

(Source: Lezhin US)

201979.description:
Money can’t buy happiness, but without it, you’re a slave to poverty.

(Source: Toomics)

201982.description:
Lyra, the only daughter of a local lord, dreams of building a warm and loving home with a wonderful husband. Marquis Jace, an older man, has given up on love, having had enough of romantic affairs. The two are engaged in a political marriage... Jace had only ever wanted a "wife in name only," but as he spends time with innocent Lyra, he begins to rediscover the love he had almost forgotten...!?

(Source: Jive, translated)

title.native: おじさま侯爵は恋するお年頃

201983.description:
"I promise, I will definitely save you..."

Mia, born into the Lucier family, a renowned family of wizards, was born with the ability to negate magic and has lived her life being treated cruelly as an "outcast." But then her father tells her that if she becomes the bride of a "cursed child" who has been cursed by a witch that has been in the royal family for 500 years, he will let her attend Priere Magic Academy, a school she has always dreamed of. In order to make her dream come true and to negate the curse, she heads to her fiancé, Helios...and so begins the romantic fantasy between a cursed child and an outcast child!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: プリエールキス～王子様の呪いを解く魔法～
title.romaji: Priere Kiss: Ouji-sama no Noroi Wotoku Mahou

201984.description:
Without realizing that she had been reincarnated as a villainous lady, Duchess Estelle's engagement to the Crown Prince was broken off. She decided to live a modest life as a commoner from now on, and decided to work at a restaurant in a neighboring country. Six years later, she was running the restaurant while raising the late owner's twin daughters, Coco and Mia, but... Duke Frederick, who claims to be the twins' older brother, visits her, and she ends up pretending to be his lover to protect the twins from being embroiled in an inheritance dispute!

A romantic fantasy about a fake engagement between a villainous lady who is at the mercy of a cold-hearted duke, unaware that she has been reincarnated into a game ♡

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 悪役令嬢はシングルマザーになりました　双子を引き取りましたが公爵様からの溺愛は想定外です
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou wa Single Mother ni Narimashita Futago wo Hikitorimashitaga Koushaku-sama Kara no Dekiai wa Souteigai desu

synonyms: Welcome to the Ant Nest Dungeon!

title.native: アリの巣ダンジョンへようこそ！
title.romaji: Ari no Su Dungeon e Youkoso!

201986.description:
Yurika wakes up to find that she has been reincarnated as Princess Lilicot of the Principality of Monsira. She realizes that she has married her fiance, Crown Prince Aquila, in place of her twin sister, but it seems that she has been treated coldly because her sister is known to be a wicked princess, and that Prince Aquila has no interest in her either...?! So she decides not to expect anything from him, to create a comfortable place for herself, and to find happiness no matter what!! But then, for some reason, Prince Aquila suddenly starts treating her kindly!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 転生公女は今さら傷つかない 姉の婚約者に嫌われていると思ったのに、溺愛されているようです?
title.romaji: Tensei Kojou wa Imasara Kizutsukanai Ane no Konyakusha ni Kirawareteiru to Omotta no ni, Dekiaisarete Iru you desu?

201987.description:
Professional caddy Katakura Kento was carrying the bag of a female pro golfer vying for the championship, but a gaffe by Kento caused her to fall to last place. He was about to take his own life after being bashed by the public, when the guardian spirit of his ancestors descended upon him. The spirit bestowed upon Kento the ability to move objects. What will Kento do with this power?! A pheromone-filled psychic golf battle!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

201988.description:
The story is set in the early Taisho era. Yanagida Soichiro, a young instructor at the Shishinkan sword-fighting dojo, struggles to attract students due to his overly strict personality, so he runs the dojo while also teaching swordsmanship at schools. One day, Soichiro meets Asahi Zaemon, a handsome seer who tells ladies' fortunes on the street. The extremely suspicious Asahi Zaemon tells Soichiro that he has the signs of death and that he will have trouble with women --!? Soichiro is outraged, thinking, "What a stupid thing to say," but then he finds himself embroiled in an unexpected and mysterious incident...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 大正もののけ闇祓い バッケ坂の怪異
title.romaji: Taisho Mononoke Yamibarai Bakkezaka no Kaii

201989.description:
To survive as someone from a lowly background I, as a doctor, had to abandon my pride If I had to bark, I barked, if I had to beg, I beggedIs this the outcome of the weak?!When frustration and anger brimmed in both eyes Facing death in a traffic accident, But when I opened my eyes again, I found myself back as an intern…!On the outside, a novice doctor in their 20s, but on the inside, a top-tier thoracic surgeon.The revenge and healing drama of Max Level Doctor Kim Yoon Chan begins.‘From now on, I will take control of every situation!’

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

201990.description:
The gods suddenly descended on the human city of Sodom. When told to bring the Demon King from the other side of Sodom, they begin slaughtering humans together. In a situation where hell is unfolding, a knight who secretly runs out of the castle goes to pick up the Demon King.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: The Idle Demon King Decided to Fight God

201991.description:
Feena, the daughter of a baron, is struggling to manage her father's estate in place of her late father. She secretly pursues the talented young Duke Leonard, known as the "Duke of Reconstruction," looking up to him as a mentor in managing the territory, and to her surprise, he ends up visiting the barony! But if it's discovered that she's involved in managing the territory despite being a woman, she'll be in grave danger of being left behind! Feena tries her best to hide it, but...

A love story that begins with admiration as she reforms the territory!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 行き遅れ令嬢が領地経営に奔走していたら立て直し公に愛されました
title.romaji: Iki Okure Reijou ga Ryouchi Keiei ni Honsou Shiteitara Tatena Oshi Kou ni Aisaremashita

201992.description:
The warriors against evil, Karuna, who face the demons, the army of hell. A youthful adventure fantasy that describes the challenges faced by Karuna!

(Source: Naver, translated)

201993.description:
Ameme Kokoro is a high school girl with the mysterious power to see into people's hearts. Kokoro is overwhelmed with emotion when she reunites with her first love, Masanao, who has a shining, beautiful heart, at an arranged marriage meeting after several years...! Kokoro tries her best to impress Masanao, but she ends up seeing into his heart...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: I Want to Be Affectionate with You

title.native: 天恵さんは甘えたいのに

201994.description:
A poor lumberjack, a young man who eats a bowl of cereal every morning. A strange story about a good-natured young man who dreams of a life free from hunger and loneliness, and a large friend who emerges from a pond instead of a tomahawk.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes 27 extra chapters.

201995.description:
"A witch becomes a real woman when she learns about love."

100 years ago, the Kingdom of Astrid was founded by four witches supporting its first king. Lil, the Rain Witch, lost her foster mother, the previous Rain Witch Alexia, and lived alone. One day, Leolart, the "Duke of Ash," appears before Lil. Leolart asks her to find the sender of a necklace that was a keepsake from his sister...!?

A tale of witches' secrets and love, weaving together the past and present.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: The Rain Witch and the Duke

title.native: 雨の魔女と灰公爵 ～白薔薇が咲かないグラウオール邸の秘密～
title.romaji: Ame no Majo to Hai Koushaku: Shirosoubi ga Sakanai Guarall-tei no Himitsu

201996.description:
A new life with ayakashi...?

Makoto Tanaka is an ordinary guy who has been accepted into the general education department at a super-advanced school. On the day of the entrance ceremony, he bumps into the petite Okitsune Kumi and hurriedly apologizes...but he has animal ears on his head!? Kumi is actually a nine-tailed fox who has come to learn about what is "normal" in the human world! He disappears in an instant, but the two convince themselves they were mistaken and become friends.

For some reason, Makoto continues to be surrounded by "unusual" students! And then there's the special education department, which doesn't like the general education department -- will Makoto be able to graduate like a "normal" person?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 普通ですが何か？最近はあやかしだって高校に行くんです。
title.romaji: Futsuu desu ga Nani ka? Saikin wa Ayakashi Datte Koukou ni Ikun desu.
